sections.heading: Reading a 0606 mark scheme the way the examiner reads it
paragraphs: Cambridge awards method credit and accuracy credit separately, and once a family understands that, a great deal of apparently mysterious marking becomes obvious. A student can reach a wrong final answer and still collect most of a question if the method was stated and followed. A student can reach the right answer and lose marks if nothing on the page shows how. This is why 'he knew how to do it' and 'he got the marks' are different claims about the same script.

The practical consequence is that working is the product, not the answer. A differentiation question asks for the derivative and then for the stationary points and then for their nature, and each of those is a separate allocation. Stopping after the coordinates forfeits the classification mark even though the student could have done it in ten seconds. Students who work quickly and tidily in their heads are the most exposed, because their scripts contain the least evidence.

The same logic governs exact form. Where the scheme specifies a surd, a logarithm or a multiple of a trigonometric constant, a decimal is a forfeit rather than an approximation. A tutor who marks a student's work the way the scheme marks it, including the forfeits, is giving the student the single piece of information school marking most often softens. Cambridge publishes its schemes on its own site; they are referenced and linked, never reproduced or supplied as downloads. One further habit follows from all this. A student who learns to read the mark allocation printed beside each question starts to budget effort against it, which quietly fixes the timing problem as well, because a six-mark question stops receiving a two-mark answer and a two-mark question stops receiving a paragraph.

sections.heading: Ten weeks of evidence: what should exist on paper by each Friday
paragraphs: A plan a parent cannot audit is not a plan. The version used here names what should physically exist at the end of each week, which turns 'we are making progress' into a document somebody can read. The first week produces the marked diagnostic and the loss ledger. The second and third produce the notation and timing repairs, because those recover marks fastest and give a demoralised student something immediate. Only then does the plan touch calculus.

Weeks four to seven are the content weeks, sequenced so the algebra a topic needs arrives before the topic does. Differentiation before kinematics. Logarithm laws before exponential equations. Circular measure before the trigonometric derivatives that assume radians. Each of those weeks produces a marked written answer on the new content and a short retrieval check on the previous week's, so the record shows retention rather than only coverage.

Weeks eight to ten produce a second timed paper, a comparison against the first by loss category, and a decision. If the ledger has moved, the plan continues to the series. If notation and timing have closed but knowledge gaps have not, the honest conclusion is that more weeks are needed and the family is told the realistic number. If nothing has moved, the approach changes rather than the hours increasing. That decision point is written into the plan at the start rather than improvised in March. Two practical notes on running this in an Ajman household. The retrieval checks are short, five or six minutes, and they are the part that stops week four's work evaporating by week eight. And the artefact is kept rather than discarded, in a single folder, because the comparison at week ten is only meaningful if the earlier work still exists to compare against.

sections.heading: Where a candidate's 0580 habits betray them in 0606
paragraphs: 0606 assumes Extended 0580 and then punishes the shortcuts that worked there. The first is calculator dependence. Extended candidates who leaned on the calculator paper arrive with weak surd and index manipulation, and 0606 asks for exact answers constantly, so a habit that cost nothing in Year 10 costs several marks per paper in Year 11. The evidence is distinctive: correct methods ending in a decimal where the scheme wanted a surd.

The second is working in degrees. Every angle a 0580 candidate has ever handled was in degrees, and 0606 expects radians in circular measure and in the calculus of trigonometric functions. The marked scripts show this as a cluster rather than as isolated errors: a whole group of questions failing with faultless methods underneath. It is one habit, and it is fixed by writing the calculator mode at the top of the working rather than by re-teaching the topic.

The third is answering less than the question asked. 0580 questions tend to be single-step; 0606 questions chain. Find the derivative, find the stationary points, determine their nature, then sketch. A student trained on single-step questions stops after step two and loses the rest, and the script looks like a knowledge gap when it is a reading habit. This is why the diagnostic classifies losses rather than counting them: the repair for a reading habit is a fortnight, and the repair for a knowledge gap is a term. The fourth habit is rounding too early. Extended papers tolerate it; 0606 chains questions, so a value rounded in part one arrives distorted in part three and costs accuracy marks twice. Carrying exact values through the working and rounding only at the point the question asks for a value is a single rule, and it is one more mark recovery that requires no new content at all.

sections.heading: What a parent should be shown each month, and what to refuse
paragraphs: A monthly record should contain four things and they are all auditable. The marked work from the month, with the examiner-style annotations visible. The loss ledger updated, so categories can be compared against the diagnostic. The list of topics covered against the syllabus, so coverage and retention are distinguishable. And a plain statement of what has not moved, which is the part most progress reports quietly omit.

What to refuse is equally specific. Refuse a percentage with no denominator: a figure describing improvement without saying out of how many marks, on which paper, under what conditions, is not information. Refuse a star rating or a satisfaction score, particularly one that cannot be traced to countable, dated, attributable reviews. Refuse any claim about a predicted grade presented as a commitment, because nobody can guarantee an outcome and the ones who do are selling something other than teaching.

Refuse, too, the comparison against an unnamed average. Several providers in this market describe their students as outperforming some unspecified cohort, and no page carries the number, the date or the method behind the claim. A statement about your child's script is checkable; a statement about an anonymous population is not. The useful question to ask any tutor, including this one, is simply: show me the marked paper and tell me which marks moved. There is one more thing a good record contains, and it is the least comfortable. A note of the sessions where nothing much happened, because the student arrived exhausted after a late school run or because a topic needed re-teaching that was supposed to be revision. A record with no bad weeks in it has been curated, and a curated record cannot be used to make a decision in March about whether the plan is working.

sections.heading: What the hourly rate does and does not include
paragraphs: Start with the part nobody asks about: marking time. An evidence-led plan means somebody marks a written answer between sessions, annotates the forfeits and updates a ledger, and that work happens outside the hour the family is paying for. When comparing rates across this market, the first question is therefore whether marking between sessions sits inside the quoted figure or outside it, because two apparently similar rates can describe quite different amounts of work.

With that framing, the published bands read differently. Budget and university-student online tuition is advertised from roughly AED 45 to 150 an hour, with EdFlik publishing from AED 45 to 65 and Tutopiya from about AED 33 to 52; at that level, marking against a published scheme is rarely part of the offer. Qualified online subject tutors publish roughly AED 150 to 300, with Unitors listing IGCSE tuition from AED 150. Named IB and IGCSE specialists sit at AED 200 to 450 and above, with TutorChase publishing AED 270, and premium or examiner-led tuition reaches AED 500 to 650 and above, with BartyED publishing AED 650.

In-home visits run roughly AED 180 to 500 an hour including travel, with Bestimate quoting AED 180 to 350 and independent home tutors AED 200 to 500. For a subject as specialist as 0606, the in-home option in Ajman has a particular weakness: the pool narrows to people who have taught this syllabus and will drive to your district at your hour, and that intersection is very small. Every figure here was published by the named provider and collected in October 2026; they are market rates rather than an IB Gram price list, and any provider should be asked for the date and source of its own.

sections.heading: The line a 0606 tutor does not cross
paragraphs: 0606 has no coursework, which removes the worst temptation in this market before it arises. There is no internal assessment anyone could improve on a student's behalf. What remains is school-set work: problem sets, mock papers, revision tasks that a teacher may collect. The boundary there is the same as everywhere else in the system, and it is worth stating because one operator found in this market sells completed internal assessments outright, which is an academic-integrity breach that puts the student at risk.

A tutor may teach the content, work a parallel problem that is not the set question, explain why an approach fails, mark the student's own attempt against the published criteria and say exactly which mark was forfeited and why. A tutor does not write the solutions a student submits. In an evidence-led plan that line is not a compliance statement; it is structural. The entire record depends on the work being the student's, because a ledger built from somebody else's mathematics measures nothing at all.

The same applies to materials. Cambridge syllabuses, past papers, mark schemes and grade thresholds belong to Cambridge, are published on its own site, and are referenced and linked rather than reproduced or distributed. And no tutor here is described as a Cambridge examiner unless that status can be evidenced, because examiner status is routinely used in this market to imply access to marking standards or paper content that nobody outside the board has.

sections.heading: Verifying the entry before buying the hours
paragraphs: The most expensive mistake in 0606 is tutoring a candidate who was never entered. It happens because the subject is optional, the decision sits with the department, and in some Ajman schools the conversation with parents never takes place. The document that settles it is the Cambridge statement of entry, which carries the syllabus code and the series. A school report does not, and a teacher's verbal assurance in October has been wrong often enough to be worth checking.

Entry deadlines sit months before the papers, which is the second thing to establish. Ajman centres enter candidates for one of two Cambridge series, June or November, and the choice between them is really a decision about resits. A June entry closes in the spring, with the school's mock window ahead of it, and the grade arrives in August. A November entry closes in the summer, which means a June result that needs improving has to be acted on within weeks of the grade landing rather than at the end of the calendar year, and 0606 is a syllabus where that window matters because the content a student has to rebuild is narrow and identifiable from the component breakdown. Cambridge also runs a February and early-March sitting, but it is offered in India only and is not available to a candidate in Ajman. The exact entry date for either UAE series is on the statement of entry the school issues, not on a tutoring site.

Two further checks belong here. Cambridge allocates every centre to one of six administrative zones and publishes a timetable for each; its exams officers' guide states that it is essential to use the correct version for your zone and that Cambridge cannot accept responsibility for candidates who miss an examination after the wrong one was used. And if any of your child's subjects sit with Pearson, note that Pearson runs International GCSE in May/June and November, with the November 2026 final timetable running from late October to 19 November 2026, and publishes provisional timetables that may be revised, so link the live official timetable rather than trusting a quoted date.

process.title: Confirm the entry exists, and read the code
process.description: Before any teaching, the Cambridge statement of entry or the school's written confirmation is checked for the syllabus code and the series. 0606 is optional and some Ajman campuses do not enter candidates, so this is the one check that can save a household an entire plan. If the entry is not yet made, the question becomes when the deadline falls.

process.title: Sit the diagnostic in the free 50-minute trial
process.description: The trial lesson is a working session. The student attempts a short set covering functions, a differentiation chain and a circular-measure question, and the tutor marks it live against the published criteria, classifying each lost mark as knowledge, method, notation or timing. That ledger is the plan. No payment is arranged before this session takes place.

process.title: Fix the slot late enough to produce usable work
process.description: Sessions run on Gulf Standard Time and are set late enough for a household where a parent drives back from Sharjah or Dubai, but not so late that the written artefact is produced by an exhausted student. Where the only viable hour is after 8pm, the work is set for the following day rather than the same evening.

process.title: Produce one marked artefact every week
process.description: Each session ends with a written answer that is marked against the scheme between sessions, with forfeits annotated rather than corrected silently. The marks are recorded by loss category and by topic, never as a single score, so the record shows what moved and what did not. That marking happens outside the paid hour.

process.title: Review at week six, decide at week ten
process.description: At week six the ledger is compared against the diagnostic. At week ten a second timed paper is sat and the two ledgers are set side by side. If the plan is working it continues; if notation and timing have closed but knowledge gaps have not, the realistic remaining time is stated plainly rather than sold as more sessions.

whyPoints.title: The diagnosis is a document, not an impression
whyPoints.description: Work starts with a timed paper marked against the published scheme and a ledger classifying every lost mark as knowledge, method, notation or timing. That document is what the plan is built from and what progress is measured against, and a parent can read it rather than take a summary on trust.

whyPoints.title: Marking happens outside the paid hour
whyPoints.description: Written work set in a session is marked between sessions, with forfeits annotated the way the scheme annotates them. That is the part of an evidence-led plan that costs time rather than showing up on an invoice, and it is the first thing to ask about when comparing one published rate with another in this market.

whyPoints.title: Notation and timing are treated as recoverable marks
whyPoints.description: A fifth of a weak 0606 script is often forfeited rather than missed: decimals where exact form was wanted, stationary points unclassified, questions never attempted. Those are discipline repairs measured in sessions, not terms, and funding them first gives a family visible movement before any expensive content work begins.

whyPoints.title: The entry is verified before the hours are sold
whyPoints.description: 0606 is optional and some Ajman campuses do not enter candidates for it. Checking the syllabus code on the statement of entry is a five-minute task that occasionally ends the conversation entirely, and doing it first is the difference between a tutoring plan and a costly misunderstanding.

whyPoints.title: No unverifiable numbers appear anywhere
whyPoints.description: No satisfaction percentage, no self-asserted rating, no comparison against an unnamed average, and no predicted grade offered as a commitment. The AED figures on this page were published by named providers and collected in October 2026 and are market rates, not an IB Gram price list.

whyPoints.title: The work stays the student's own
whyPoints.description: A tutor teaches, marks and explains; a tutor does not produce the solutions a student submits. In an evidence-led plan that is structural rather than decorative, because a progress record built from somebody else's mathematics measures nothing. Cambridge materials are referenced and linked, never reproduced or distributed.

faqs.question: How will I know whether 0606 tutoring is actually working?
faqs.answer: By comparing two marked papers and two loss ledgers. The first timed paper is sat in the opening week and every lost mark is classified as a knowledge gap, a method gap, a notation forfeit or a timing loss. A second paper is sat around week ten and the two ledgers are placed side by side. That shows, in marks, which categories closed and which did not. It is a far more useful statement than a percentage improvement, because it tells you what the hours bought and what still needs buying. Nobody can promise a particular grade, and the evidence is shown whether it is flattering or not.

faqs.question: Why does my son lose marks when his final answers are right?
faqs.answer: Because Cambridge awards method credit and accuracy credit separately, and a script that shows no working contains no evidence for the method marks. A student who differentiates mentally and writes only the coordinates of a stationary point has forfeited the mark for naming the rule and the mark for classifying the point, even though he could do both. Quick, tidy workers are the most exposed to this. The repair is presentation discipline rather than content: state the rule, show the substitution, answer every part of the question. It takes two or three sessions and recovers marks without teaching anything new.

faqs.question: What is the single most common 0606 error in marked scripts?
faqs.answer: Evaluating a correct trigonometric or circular-measure method with the calculator in degrees. 0606 is the first course most of these students meet where radians are a working unit rather than a curiosity, and the error shows up as a cluster: a whole group of questions failing with faultless methods underneath. It looks like a knowledge gap and is a habit. The fix is to write the calculator mode at the top of the working on every question until it is automatic, which is one session plus a fortnight of consistency, and it is usually the fastest mark recovery available in the subject.

faqs.question: Does Additional Maths 0606 have a Core and Extended tier?
faqs.answer: No. Unlike Mathematics 0580, Physics 0625 and Chemistry 0620, Additional Mathematics has no tiered entry: every candidate sits the same two papers. The grade range runs from A* to E, which has a consequence worth understanding. There is a floor as well as a ceiling, so a candidate who is genuinely out of their depth does not fail into a lower tier, they simply fall below the awarded range. That makes the viability question honest and early: a diagnostic paper in the autumn tells a family whether the entry is realistic while there is still time to act on the answer.

faqs.question: My daughter's Ajman school entered her for 0606 but barely teaches it. What now?
faqs.answer: That is a teaching load, not a consolidation load, and the plan has to say so. Some campuses enter candidates who are expected to cover most of the syllabus independently alongside Extended 0580, and a household that books one session a week for consolidation will be funding something that cannot work. The honest version is roughly two sessions a week from the autumn, with the syllabus sequenced so the algebra arrives before the calculus, written work marked between sessions, and a stated point at which the plan is judged viable or abandoned. Establish which of the three situations she is in before agreeing any number of hours.

faqs.question: How many weeks does calculus actually take from a standing start?
faqs.answer: On marked evidence from this market, differentiation to a usable standard takes four to six weeks of weekly work with marked practice in between, and integration adds a further three or four. Those numbers assume the algebra underneath is secure; where indices, surds and function manipulation are weak, add two weeks at the front because calculus taught on shaky algebra does not retain. Kinematics sits last because it is calculus applied to a story, and it is quick once the derivative work is automatic. A diagnostic in the first week tells you which of those timelines is yours.

faqs.question: What should a monthly progress report on 0606 contain?
faqs.answer: Four things. The marked work from the month with examiner-style annotations visible. The loss ledger updated so categories can be compared against the first diagnostic. The topics covered set against the syllabus, so coverage and retention are distinguishable. And a plain statement of what has not moved. Refuse a percentage with no denominator, a star rating that cannot be traced to countable dated reviews, a comparison against an unnamed average, and any predicted grade presented as a commitment. A statement about your child's script is checkable; a statement about an anonymous cohort is not.

faqs.question: Does the quoted hourly rate include marking between sessions?
faqs.answer: Ask, because this is where two apparently similar rates describe different amounts of work. An evidence-led plan means somebody marks written answers against the published scheme, annotates forfeits and updates a ledger, and that happens outside the hour the family pays for. In the published bands, budget online tuition runs roughly AED 45 to 150 an hour and rarely includes scheme-accurate marking; qualified online subject tutors publish about AED 150 to 300; named specialists AED 200 to 450 and above. Those were collected from named providers in October 2026 and are market rates, not an IB Gram price list.

faqs.question: Is a university-student tutor enough for Additional Maths?
faqs.answer: Sometimes for the algebra, rarely for the examination technique, and the way to find out is a practical test rather than a credential check. Ask the candidate how they would mark a stationary-point question: a tutor who knows the subject will mention the rule statement, the derivative set to zero, the coordinates and the classification as separate allocations. One who talks only about getting the right answer has not marked against a scheme. Budget tuition at the published AED 45 to 150 band genuinely helps with routine and confidence; 0606 marks are mostly lost in places that need somebody who has marked the paper.

faqs.question: Can one tutor teach both 0580 Extended and 0606?
faqs.answer: Often yes, and it is usually the sensible arrangement because the subjects share algebra and a tutor who sees both scripts spots a habit travelling between them. The condition is two separate diagnostics rather than one shared assessment, because a single paper covering both tends to flatter the student in whichever subject it leans towards, and two ledgers keep movement in one subject from hiding inside an average. Scheduling the two sessions back to back on one evening also protects the rest of the week, which most Ajman households value more than a small discount.

faqs.question: How do I check the 0606 entry really exists?
faqs.answer: Read the Cambridge statement of entry, which carries the syllabus code and the series. A school report does not, and a verbal assurance in October has been wrong often enough to be worth verifying in writing. Entry deadlines also sit months before the papers, and in Ajman the entry is for either the June series or the November one; the February and early-March sitting that appears in a lot of search results is run for India only. A June entry closes in the spring and a November entry in the summer, so the useful question to the exams officer is narrow: when does the final entry for our series close, which tier and syllabus code is my child down for, and is the entry actually submitted. Ask it in writing while there is still time to change the answer.

faqs.question: Which Cambridge timetable applies to my child's centre?
faqs.answer: The one for the administrative zone the centre is allocated to. Cambridge places every centre in one of six zones and publishes a separate timetable for each, and its exams officers' guide states that it is essential to use the correct version for your zone, adding that Cambridge cannot accept responsibility for candidates who miss an examination after the wrong version was used. Ask the exams officer which zone applies and get it in writing. For any Pearson subjects, note that Pearson publishes provisional timetables that may be revised, so work from the live official timetable rather than a quoted date.

faqs.question: Will a tutor write my son's problem-set solutions for him?
faqs.answer: No, and in an evidence-led plan that line is structural rather than decorative. A tutor may teach the content, work a parallel problem that is not the set question, explain why an approach fails, and mark your son's own attempt against the published criteria, naming exactly which mark was forfeited. A tutor does not produce the solutions he submits, because a progress ledger built from somebody else's mathematics measures nothing and the grade it predicts collapses in the examination room. One operator in this market sells completed assessed work outright; that is a malpractice risk for the student and nothing here resembles it.

faqs.question: Is 0606 worth taking if my child is applying to a UAE university?
faqs.answer: It can help as preparation but it is not a requirement, and nothing about tutoring is required for admission or for certificate equivalency. For the British track, the published Ministry of Education equivalency rule is five accredited GCSE or IGCSE subjects at a grade of no less than E or grade 3, with Arabic and Islamic education excluded from that count, plus one Advanced Level subject at no less than E or two at Advanced Subsidiary Level. 0606 can form part of the five but no particular subject is specified. Equivalency is run by the Ministry and the emirate's attestation channel; IB Gram neither performs nor guarantees any part of it.

faqs.question: What if no 0606 specialist is free at the hour we need?
faqs.answer: You will be told before anything is booked. Additional Mathematics is a genuinely specialist syllabus and the number of tutors who have taught it and marked against its schemes is small, so a particular weekday evening may be unavailable, especially the post-7pm slots most Ajman commuting households need. The options are a different hour, a short wait for one to open, or a named specialist based outside the UAE teaching on Gulf Standard Time, disclosed in advance with the rate. What you will not be offered is a general maths tutor presented as a 0606 specialist.

ajman/cambridge-igcse-additional-maths-0.closingHeading: Bring the script, not the report card
ajman/cambridge-igcse-additional-maths-0.closingBody: The useful first conversation about 0606 starts with a piece of marked mathematics. Send the most recent paper your daughter sat, along with the statement of entry showing the syllabus code and series, and take the free 50-minute trial lesson. That session produces a timed set, marked live against the published criteria, with each lost mark classified as a knowledge gap, a method gap, a notation forfeit or a timing loss. From there the number of weeks required is an arithmetic question rather than a guess, and you will be told if it does not fit the time left. Lessons run one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time.

intro.heading: A 0610 bill is set by the papers your child sits, not by an hourly rate
paragraphs: Most families in Ajman arrive at this question through a report card rather than a plan. The Biology grade has come back two bands below the prediction, the science teacher has mentioned the practical paper, and the first thing a parent wants to know is what repairing that costs. No single hourly rate answers it, because Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 is not one examination. It is three papers sat in one of two tiers, and the tier decides both the ceiling on the certificate and the number of hours any tutor needs to get near it.

The rates themselves are findable if you look past the brochures. EdFlik advertises online tuition from AED 45 to 65 an hour and Tutopiya from roughly AED 33 to 52. Unitors lists IGCSE tuition from AED 150. TutorChase quotes around AED 270 for specialist IGCSE and IB work. The Bestimate tutoring-cost survey for 2026 places in-home one-to-one between AED 180 and 350, and subject specialists between AED 200 and 450 and above. Those are the market's own published numbers, dated October 2026, and they are the numbers this page works from. They are not an IB Gram price list; our own figure comes out of a consultation after we know which papers your child is entered for.

What those bands hide is that the same hour does very different work depending on where it is spent. An hour drilling multiple-choice recall for Paper 1 is nearly interchangeable between tutors, and the cheapest competent option is usually the right one. An hour spent marking a Paper 4 structured answer against the mark scheme, line by line, with the student rewriting it while the tutor watches, is a different product, and the price difference between those two hours is the whole argument of this page.

Ajman adds its own distortions. Private schools in the emirate sit under the federal Ministry of Education rather than an emirate-level authority, and the private-school set is small compared with Dubai or Sharjah. A large share of Ajman households have at least one parent commuting to Dubai or Sharjah, which pushes a realistic weeknight session to 7pm or later. It also means the local pool of people who have actually taught 0610 Extended to examination is thin, and scarcity shows up in a quote long before quality does.

So the sections below do four things in order: they split the 0610 grade into its components and attach hours to each, they compare Core against Extended on what each costs to teach, they publish the AED market table with sources, and they list the things that move a quote in this emirate specifically. There is also a section on what to try before paying anybody, because several of the cheapest fixes for a 0610 mark cost nothing at all.

One point before any of it. Tutoring for families here is delivered one-to-one over live video. IB Gram does not send tutors to homes anywhere in the UAE; home visits are a service we run only in India. That is stated plainly because it changes the arithmetic in your favour rather than against it, and the comparison table further down shows exactly where.

ajman/cambridge-igcse-biology-0610-tutor.programmesIntro: Biology 0610 does not sit on its own. It is part of a route that usually starts in the Middle Years Programme or a British Key Stage 3 and ends in a Diploma or A Level science. Each stage below is described for what it costs a family in Ajman to support, not for what it looks like in a prospectus.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE
programmes.description: The two-year course that ends in the 0610 papers. Most Ajman schools begin it in Year 10 and finish teaching the syllabus some time in the spring of Year 11, which leaves a short revision window and a long autumn where nothing feels urgent. Biology is examined on all twenty-one topics regardless of the order a school teaches them, so a student who missed a term of Transport in Animals will meet it again in the paper.
programmes.countryNote: Ajman private schools offering Cambridge IGCSE sit under federal Ministry of Education oversight, which regulates the schools rather than the examination. Cambridge sets the syllabus, the entry deadlines and the zone timetable; the school chooses the tier and the practical route. Parents in Ajman often discover the tier only when a mock paper comes home with Core printed on it, which is late in the process to be having that conversation.

programmes.name: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE
programmes.description: The other board several Ajman and Sharjah schools use. Edexcel International GCSE Biology is a different specification with different papers and a different approach to practical skills, which are assessed inside the written papers rather than through a separate practical test. A tutor buying Cambridge 0610 past papers for an Edexcel candidate is wasting both of your money, so the first question in any trial lesson should be which board the school entered the child for.
programmes.countryNote: Pearson runs International GCSE series in May/June and November. The November 2026 final timetable ran from late October to 19 November 2026, June 2026 results reached centres on 19 August 2026 and students on 20 August 2026, and November 2025 results reached students on 22 January 2026. Those are Pearson's own published dates and the live timetable should always be checked on the Pearson qualifications site before anyone plans a revision schedule around them.

programmes.name: IB Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: Some Ajman and Sharjah schools run the MYP to Year 11 rather than an IGCSE. MYP Sciences is assessed against four criteria rather than a timed paper, which means a student can arrive in a Diploma or A Level science without ever having written a structured answer under a clock. Families who then move a child into an IGCSE cohort mid-course usually need a short block of paid hours purely to teach examination technique.
programmes.countryNote: The MYP-to-IGCSE transfer is more common in the northern emirates than people assume, because families move between schools when they move between Ajman, Sharjah and Dubai for work. The cost of that transfer is almost always underestimated: the content gap is small, the assessment-habit gap is large, and the second is the one that shows up in a December mock.

programmes.name: IB Diploma Programme Biology
programmes.description: Where a strong 0610 Extended grade usually leads. Diploma Biology at Standard or Higher Level assumes the cell biology, genetics and physiology of the IGCSE course and moves straight into detail. Students who scraped a grade 6 at Extended tend to meet the gap in the first term of Year 12, which is why a family that invested properly in Year 11 often spends less in Year 12 than one that did not.
programmes.countryNote: No IB session or results date is published on this page. The IB's own site blocks automated checking, so any Diploma date a family plans around should be confirmed with the school's IB coordinator or on ibo.org directly. What can be said safely is that UAE schools sit the May session, and that the internal assessment deadlines inside a school sit months ahead of it.

ajman/cambridge-igcse-biology-0610-tutor.subjectsIntro: The 0610 syllabus has twenty-one topics. They do not cost the same to teach. The ten clusters below are the ones that absorb most paid hours in practice, with a note on where the marks actually go missing in each. A tutor who cannot tell you which of these your child is weak in after one session has not run a diagnostic.

subjects.name: Enzymes and biological molecules
subjects.description: The commonest early loss. Students describe an enzyme as being killed by heat rather than denatured, and lose the mark for the change in active-site shape. Extended candidates also need the effect of pH and the idea of a specific substrate. Cheap to fix, usually two sessions, and worth fixing first because the vocabulary recurs in digestion, respiration and photosynthesis questions.

subjects.name: Movement into and out of cells
subjects.description: Diffusion, osmosis and active transport. The Extended supplement requires water potential language and the energy requirement for active transport. Marks disappear in the osmosis practical questions, where students describe mass change without referring to water moving down a concentration gradient through a partially permeable membrane. It is examined in both the theory and the practical papers, so the hours here pay twice.

subjects.name: Plant nutrition and transport in plants
subjects.description: Photosynthesis, limiting factors, transpiration and translocation. The limiting-factor graph is a reliable source of lost marks because students name the factor without saying what is happening at the plateau. Transpiration questions reward precise wording about the effect of wind, humidity and temperature on the rate, and a vague answer scores nothing even when the biology behind it is right.

subjects.name: Human nutrition and digestion
subjects.description: The food tests sit here, which ties this topic directly to the practical component. Benedict's, iodine, biuret and the ethanol emulsion test have to be reproducible from memory, with the starting colour, the final colour and the condition stated. Students who learn only the colour change lose the mark for naming the reagent or the need to heat. Expect two paid hours, no more.

subjects.name: Transport in animals and gas exchange
subjects.description: Heart structure, blood vessels, the double circulation and the lungs. The reliably difficult part is explaining why ventricle walls differ in thickness and relating the answer to pressure and distance. Gas-exchange questions want surface area, moisture, thin walls and a maintained gradient, and the fourth of those is the one most often missed.

subjects.name: Respiration and excretion
subjects.description: Aerobic and anaerobic respiration, the word and symbol equations, oxygen debt at Extended, and the role of the kidney and liver. Students confuse breathing with respiration in almost every cohort, and an answer that uses the two interchangeably is marked wrong even where the reasoning is sound. Excretion is short and frequently skipped in school revision, which makes it cheap marks for anyone who covers it.

subjects.name: Coordination and response
subjects.description: Reflex arcs, the eye, hormones, homeostasis and tropisms. Homeostasis questions ask for negative feedback in sequence: receptor, coordination centre, effector, correction. Students who write the parts in the wrong order lose the sequence mark even with every component named. The eye and the reflex arc are diagram-heavy, which is why they work well in a shared-screen session where the tutor can annotate as the student labels.

subjects.name: Reproduction in plants and humans
subjects.description: Flower structure, pollination, fertilisation, the menstrual cycle, and sexually transmitted infection at Extended. The weakest answers describe pollination and fertilisation as the same event. The menstrual-cycle hormone graph rewards students who can name the hormone, its source and its effect together, which is three marks that regularly come back as one.

subjects.name: Inheritance, variation and selection
subjects.description: The one area of 0610 with genuine method marks. Punnett squares, monohybrid crosses, codominance and sex linkage are marked on working as well as outcome, so a student who writes the correct ratio without the gametes scores less than one who sets it out properly and slips at the end. This is the topic where paid hours convert most directly into marks.

subjects.name: Ecology, human influence and biotechnology
subjects.description: Food chains, energy transfer, the carbon and nitrogen cycles, pollution, conservation and genetic modification. It sits at the end of the syllabus, is taught last, and is therefore the material a February mock finds empty. It is also largely recall, which makes it the cheapest block on the list to repair and the worst use of an expensive specialist hour.

ajman/cambridge-igcse-biology-0610-tutor.regionsIntro: Ajman is compact, and a tutoring decision here is shaped less by distance than by which direction the household drives in the morning. These notes are about session timing and school intake rather than scenery, because those are the two things that actually decide whether a weekly Biology slot survives past week four.

regions.name: Al Nuaimiya

sections.heading: What an Ajman parent is actually buying when they search for 0610 help
paragraphs: A search for a Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 tutor in Ajman is, nine times in ten, a search for a number. The parent has a mock result, an idea that something should be done, and no way to judge whether AED 120 an hour is a bargain or a warning sign. The published market gives a range rather than an answer: roughly AED 33 to 65 at the budget end, AED 150 to 300 for a qualified subject tutor working online, and AED 200 to 450 and above for a specialist, with in-home visits sitting between AED 180 and 500 once travel is folded in. All of those are the market's figures, dated October 2026, and none of them is a price for your child's situation.

The reason the range is so wide is that the word tutor covers two different products. One is supervised practice: somebody competent sits with a student, keeps them working, explains what is unclear and gets through more past-paper questions than the student would alone. That is worth the budget rate and no more. The other is diagnosis and marking: somebody who knows the 0610 mark scheme reads a written answer, identifies which of the four or five expected points is missing, and makes the student produce the missing one in writing before the session ends. That takes subject knowledge and costs accordingly.

Which one your child needs is decided by the mock script, not by the budget. A student scoring 55% on Paper 4 with scattered partial credit across every question needs the second product. A student scoring 55% because they ran out of time and left the last four questions blank needs the first, plus a clock. The diagnostic in a first session exists to tell those two apart, and any tutor who quotes a package before reading a script is guessing.

The rest of this page assumes you want to know where each paid hour goes. It splits 0610 into the components Cambridge actually examines, attaches a realistic range of hours to each, prices the market, and then lists the local conditions in Ajman that push a quote up or down. It also names the parts you should not pay for at all.

sections.heading: The 0610 components, and which of them absorb paid hours
paragraphs: Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 is assessed through three papers. Which three depends on the tier. Core candidates sit Paper 1, a 45-minute multiple-choice paper worth 40 marks and 30% of the grade, and Paper 3, a structured theory paper of 1 hour 15 minutes worth 80 marks and 50%. Extended candidates sit Paper 2 and Paper 4, the same formats with supplement content. Both tiers then sit either Paper 5, a practical test in the school's laboratory worth 40 marks, or Paper 6, the written alternative to practical worth the same, each carrying 20% of the final grade.

That distribution is the whole argument for where money goes. Half the grade sits in one structured theory paper. A fifth sits in a practical component that many schools revise late and some barely revise at all. Less than a third sits in multiple choice, which is the cheapest thing on the list to improve because it responds to volume rather than expertise. A family paying specialist rates to drill multiple choice is buying the wrong hour.

The hours in the table below are ranges observed across students who started from a mock in the 40 to 60 per cent band, not promises. A student starting lower needs more; a student who is simply careless needs fewer than any of these. They are offered so that a quote can be checked against something. If a provider proposes thirty hours and twenty of them are aimed at Paper 1, that proposal can be read for what it is.

One component is worth singling out. Paper 4 is the only place in 0610 where the exact phrasing of a written answer regularly decides the mark, and it is also where the mark scheme is least intuitive to a student. An answer that is biologically true can score zero because it does not contain the comparative word the scheme requires. That is a teachable skill, it takes marked written practice rather than explanation, and it is the single most defensible line on a 0610 invoice.

sections.heading: Core or Extended: the entry that sets the ceiling before any money is spent
paragraphs: The most expensive mistake available to an Ajman family is paying for a year of Extended-level teaching for a child the school has entered at Core, or the reverse. The two tiers use different papers, different past-paper sets and different mark schemes. A tutor working from the wrong set is not partially useful; they are teaching a syllabus the student will not sit.

Core covers the core content of all twenty-one topics and leads to grades C through G. Extended adds supplement material in most topics and leads to grades A* through E. The practical component is common to both. The decision belongs to the school and is made against the Cambridge entry deadline, which falls months before the paper, so a mock result in March is often reacting to a decision already locked in November.

This matters to cost in a direct way. A Core student is usually buying practice and structure, which the market supplies at its lower rates. An Extended student is often buying teaching of material the school has covered quickly, which is where the AED 200 to 450 specialist band becomes defensible. Parents who do not know which tier their child is entered for should ask the science coordinator for the entry record in writing, and should do it before taking a quote, not after.

There is one more consequence worth stating without dressing it up. A Core entry means the certificate cannot show a grade above C, however well the papers go. For a student who intends to continue to A Level or IB Diploma Biology, that is not a small matter, and no amount of tutoring changes it after the entry deadline has passed. Where a tier change still looks possible and justified, the conversation to have is with the school, not with a tutor.

sections.heading: What the market charges, with the source for every figure
paragraphs: Three of the six most visible tutoring pages in this market publish no price at all, and the two that do quote in US dollars, which is not the currency an Ajman family transacts in. The table below collects what is actually published, in AED, with the provider attached to each band. It is a market survey, not our rate card.

Read it with two things in mind. First, an advertised from rate is a starting point for the easiest possible booking: a younger student, a common subject, an off-peak slot. A Year 11 Extended Biology student in February is none of those things, and the real quote will sit higher in the band than the headline. Second, an in-home rate has travel inside it whether or not the invoice says so. A tutor driving forty minutes each way to Al Mowaihat is pricing eighty minutes of their evening into a sixty-minute lesson, and that is why the in-home band sits where it does.

Monthly packages are common and need the same scepticism. Advertised offers in this market include AED 799 a month for eight online sessions, and AED 1,599 to 1,799 a month for four two-hour in-home sessions. Divide before comparing: the first is close to AED 100 an hour, the second works out near AED 200 to 225. The Bestimate survey's monthly estimates for a single weekly hour run AED 240 to 600 at the budget end, AED 600 to 1,200 in the middle, and AED 1,000 to 2,000 and above for specialist exam-year work.

IB Gram's own position is deliberately not a row in this table. Our figure depends on the tier, the subject and how many weeks remain before the series, and it is quoted in a consultation after a trial lesson rather than guessed from a URL. What can be said in advance is that there is no travel line in it, because the lessons are delivered over live video.

sections.heading: Six things that move a 0610 quote up or down in Ajman specifically
paragraphs: Generic rate tables stop being useful the moment you ask for a quote, because the quote is shaped by local conditions. In this emirate six of them do most of the work, and knowing which ones apply to your household lets you tell a fair number from an opportunistic one.

The first is scarcity. Ajman's private-school set is small, and the number of people locally who have taught Extended Biology through to a series is smaller still. Scarcity raises in-home rates far more sharply than it raises online ones, because an online pool is not bounded by a driving radius. The second is timing: a request made in October for a weekly slot is priced differently from the same request made in March, when every competent Biology tutor in the northern emirates is already booked through the series.

The third is the slot itself. With a large share of Ajman parents commuting to Dubai or Sharjah, demand concentrates after 7pm, and the evening peak carries a premium in any market with a fixed supply of hours. A family that can take a 4.30pm slot on a Friday is buying from a much less crowded shelf. The fourth is the number of subjects: a single tutor covering Biology alongside a second science usually quotes a lower per-hour figure than two separate specialists, though only if they genuinely teach both to examination level.

The fifth is whether marking is included. An hour that ends with a marked written answer costs more to deliver than an hour of explanation, and a quote that is cheap per hour but produces nothing in writing is not cheaper per mark. The sixth is the tier, which is the one already covered above and the one most parents do not think to mention when asking for a price. A quote given without it is a quote given blind.

sections.heading: The practical component: a fifth of the grade and the hardest hour to buy locally
paragraphs: Twenty per cent of the 0610 grade comes from either Paper 5, a practical test sat in the school's laboratory, or Paper 6, a written paper about experimental work. Which one a student sits is a school decision made at entry. Many Ajman families do not know which applies to their child, and a surprising number of students find out in the examination hall.

That matters commercially, because the two routes have completely different costs. Paper 6 is a written paper. It rewards knowing how to tabulate results, plot a graph properly, identify the independent and dependent variables, name a control, state a source of error and propose an improvement that is actually testable. Every one of those is teachable over a shared screen with past-paper questions, and it is among the best value blocks a family can buy, because schools routinely under-revise it.

Paper 5 is harder to help with honestly. The student handles apparatus in their own school laboratory, and no tutor can replicate that. What a tutor can do is drill the thinking that surrounds the practical work: how to record repeat readings, when to discard an anomalous result and say so, how to describe a method so another person could follow it, and how to answer the evaluation questions that carry marks at the end. Any provider claiming to deliver laboratory practice remotely is selling something that does not exist.

The practical papers also reach backwards into the theory course. The food tests belong to human nutrition. The osmosis investigation belongs to movement into and out of cells. The photosynthesis rate experiment belongs to plant nutrition. A block of practical work therefore repairs theory topics at the same time, which is the reason it tends to be the most efficient spend in the whole 0610 plan.

sections.heading: Spending nothing first: what moves a 0610 mark without a tutor
paragraphs: Several of the most reliable improvements in a Biology grade cost nothing, and a page that prices tutoring without saying so is not being straight with you. Start with the school. Ask the science teacher for the mark breakdown of the last mock by question rather than the total. A total tells you there is a problem; the breakdown tells you whether it is recall, application, practical or timing, and those four problems have four different solutions, only two of which need paying for.

Next, ask which tier and which practical route your child is entered for, in writing. It is free, it takes one email, and it prevents the single most expensive error described on this page. While you are asking, request the school's scheme of work for the rest of the year, so that any tutoring you do buy can follow the class rather than run parallel to it.

Then there is the student's own past-paper habit. Working through questions with the mark scheme open beside them teaches nothing, because recognising a correct answer is not the same as producing one. Working through them closed, then marking honestly against the scheme afterwards and writing out the corrected version, is the single highest-return unpaid activity available in this course. Cambridge publishes specimen and past materials through schools and its own channels; your child's teacher is the right route to them, and nobody should be supplying copies of board material outside that.

If, after all that, the gaps are specific and the student is still short, that is the point at which paid hours start earning their rate. A tutor working on a diagnosed list of three topics and a known paper is worth considerably more per hour than one hired to be generally helpful, and will usually be needed for fewer hours.

sections.heading: Entries, series and the dates that cost money when missed
paragraphs: Cambridge runs IGCSE examinations in a June series and a November series, with Checkpoint tests in March, May and October. Every examination centre is allocated to one of six administrative zones, and Cambridge is explicit that it is essential to use the correct version of the timetable for your zone and that it cannot accept responsibility for candidates who miss an examination after consulting the wrong one. For a family in Ajman whose child sits papers at a Sharjah or Dubai centre, checking the zone against the school's own timetable is a five-minute job worth doing.

The gap between entry and examination is larger than most parents expect, and it is the reason a tier conversation in March is usually too late. For the June series the final entry closes in the spring, months ahead of the first paper, and once it closes the tier a candidate is entered at is fixed for that sitting. The only route to a different tier after that is the November series, whose own entry closes in the summer. Forecast grades go to Cambridge through the centre before the papers are sat, results reach candidates in August for a June entry and in January for a November one, and certificates follow some weeks later. One warning about what a search for Cambridge key dates returns: the February and early-March sitting that comes up first, with its own published deadlines, is offered to candidates in India only, so none of those dates apply to a child sitting 0610 in Ajman. The deadline that binds your child is the one printed on the statement of entry the school issues, and the exams officer can confirm it in writing.

Pearson's International GCSE calendar runs on its own schedule, with series in May/June and November. The November 2026 final timetable ran from late October to 19 November 2026; June 2026 results reached centres on 19 August 2026 and students on 20 August 2026; November 2025 results reached students on 22 January 2026. Pearson also publishes provisional timetables ahead of each series, which is why any plan should be built against the live official timetable rather than against a date copied from a page like this one.

Counted backwards from a June paper, the useful markers are simple. The autumn term is when a weekly slot is cheap and available. The winter mock is the diagnostic that tells you what to buy. February and March are when the practical component should be addressed, because it is the part the school revises last. April is for timed full papers. May is for sleep, and for nothing that a tutor can sell you.

sections.heading: What the fee does not buy, and the line a tutor works inside
paragraphs: No fee buys a grade. Any provider offering one in this market should be read carefully, because a promise of a specific outcome in a public examination is a claim nobody can honour and a claim UAE consumer rules take seriously. What a fee buys is teaching time, marking and a record of what changed, and a parent is entitled to see all three.

A fee also does not buy coursework. Cambridge IGCSE Biology has no written coursework component, but the honesty principle still applies to practical write-ups and any school-assessed work: a tutor teaches method, explains where a scheme awards marks, and gives feedback on work the student has produced themselves. A tutor who offers to supply finished answers for submission is creating a malpractice risk that sits with the student, not with them.

Nor does a fee buy board material. Syllabus documents, past papers, mark schemes and grade-boundary tables belong to Cambridge and Pearson, and the right route to them is the school or the board's own site. Reference them, link to them, work from what the school provides; do not accept a provider distributing copies as a selling point.

On the legal side, private tutoring in the UAE is permitted work rather than casual work. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is granted free of charge for two years, and covers categories including registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. MoHRE's own service page, Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing, lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time. Individuals offering private tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws; no schedule of amounts is published, so none is quoted here. It is a fair question to ask anyone you are about to pay.

process.title: Send the mock script, not the grade
process.description: The useful first message contains the last Biology paper with the marks shown by question, the tier your child is entered for if you know it, and the practical route. A grade on its own tells us almost nothing. A script tells us whether the problem is recall, phrasing, application or the clock, and those need different tutors and different numbers of hours.

process.title: A free 50-minute trial lesson
process.description: One lesson with no card details taken beforehand and no commitment afterwards. It runs as a diagnostic: a few questions across different topics and command words, a written answer produced and marked live, and a direct opinion at the end about what is wrong and roughly how long it takes to fix. If the answer is that you do not need paid hours, that is what you will be told.

process.title: A written plan with a number attached
process.description: After the trial you get the topic list in priority order, the papers each session targets, the number of sessions proposed and what that costs in AED. The plan says which parts you should do without us, because several of them are free. Nothing is charged until you agree the plan, and the plan is a working document rather than a package.

process.title: Weekly sessions with written output
process.description: Each session leaves something behind: a marked answer, a corrected version written by the student, and a short note on what to practise before the next one. That record is what makes progress arguable rather than felt, and it is what you should ask any provider for regardless of whether you work with us.

process.title: A review at week six, honestly
process.description: Six sessions in, we compare the diagnostic against a fresh timed paper and say whether the change is real. If the marks have moved, the plan continues and may shorten. If they have not, we change the tutor or tell you the approach is wrong. Continuing to invoice while nothing moves is the commonest failure in this market and the easiest one to avoid.

whyPoints.title: Prices on the page, with sources
whyPoints.description: Every AED figure here is attributed to the provider that published it and dated to October 2026. Three of the most visible competitor pages in this market publish no price at all, and one of them asks the price question in its own FAQ and then declines to answer it. A family should be able to judge a quote before speaking to anybody.

whyPoints.title: The tier question asked first
whyPoints.description: Core and Extended are different courses with different papers and different mark schemes. We ask which one your child is entered for before quoting, because a quote issued without it is guesswork and a tutor working from the wrong past papers is worse than no tutor at all.

whyPoints.title: Delivery stated plainly
whyPoints.description: Lessons are one-to-one over live video. IB Gram does not send tutors to homes in the UAE; home visits are a service we offer only in India. Saying so lets a family compare like with like instead of discovering the format after payment, and it removes the travel line that sits silently inside every in-home rate.

whyPoints.title: A pool that is not bounded by a driving radius
whyPoints.description: The constraint on Biology help in Ajman is not money; it is how few people within a short drive have taught Extended 0610 through to a series. Video delivery replaces a radius with availability, which is the one structural advantage of the format and the reason it is the format we use.

whyPoints.title: Marked written work, every session
whyPoints.description: Half the 0610 grade sits in a structured theory paper where phrasing decides marks. That skill is built by writing answers and having them marked against the scheme, not by listening to explanations. Every session produces a marked answer and a corrected rewrite, and you can read both.

whyPoints.title: The honest no
whyPoints.description: If a trial lesson shows that the gap is timing or effort rather than understanding, we say so and do not sell you twenty hours. If no specialist is free for the subject and slot you need, we say that too rather than filling the slot with somebody who teaches a different science.

faqs.question: What does a Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 tutor cost per hour for a family in Ajman?
faqs.answer: The published market in the UAE runs from roughly AED 33 to 65 an hour for generalist online tuition, AED 150 to 300 for a qualified subject tutor working online, and AED 200 to 450 and above for an IGCSE or IB specialist. In-home visits sit between AED 180 and 500 because travel is priced inside the rate. Those figures come from EdFlik, Tutopiya, Unitors, TutorChase and the Bestimate 2026 rate survey, read in October 2026. IB Gram quotes after a free trial lesson, once the tier and the time remaining before the series are known, and there is no travel line in it.

faqs.question: Is Biology 0610 cheaper to tutor than Chemistry 0620 or Physics 0625?
faqs.answer: Slightly, in most of this market, and for a supply reason rather than a difficulty one. More teachers are comfortable teaching Biology to IGCSE level than are comfortable with Physics, so the pool is deeper and the scarcity premium is smaller. That gap narrows sharply at the Extended tier and disappears entirely in February and March, when every competent science tutor in the northern emirates is booked. If a quote for Biology comes in above the specialist band, ask what is in the hour that justifies it, and expect the answer to involve marking.

faqs.question: How many paid hours does a Year 11 Biology student in Ajman usually need?
faqs.answer: It depends almost entirely on where the marks are being lost. A student at 55 per cent on Paper 4 with scattered partial credit across every question is typically looking at fifteen to twenty-five hours spread over a term, because the work is marked written practice and that cannot be compressed. A student at the same mark who simply ran out of time needs perhaps six, plus a clock. A student missing whole topics needs a plan with the school rather than a tutor. The diagnostic in a first lesson exists to tell these apart before anyone commits.

faqs.question: Does preparing for Paper 6 cost less than preparing for Paper 5?
faqs.answer: Preparation for Paper 6 is usually better value, because Paper 6 is a written paper about experiments and therefore responds directly to written practice over a shared screen. Variables, tables, graph plotting, sources of error and improvements are all teachable remotely and are reliably under-revised in school. Paper 5 is a practical test sat in the school laboratory, so a tutor can teach method, recording and evaluation but cannot replicate the apparatus. Both carry 20 per cent of the grade. The first thing to establish is which route your child's school entered them for, because the two need different work.

faqs.question: My son is entered for Core Biology. Is it worth paying to move him up to Extended?
faqs.answer: A tier change is a school decision taken against the Cambridge entry deadline, not something tutoring can arrange, so the first conversation is with the science coordinator rather than with us. Where a change is still possible, the question is whether the student can absorb the supplement material in the time left and still hold the core content securely. If the answer is yes, the certificate ceiling moves from grade C to A*, which matters for any route into A Level or Diploma Biology. If the answer is no, paying for Extended teaching buys a worse Core result.

faqs.question: Are there cheaper ways to raise a 0610 grade in Ajman than one-to-one tutoring?
faqs.answer: Several, and they should be tried first. Ask the school for the mock mark breakdown by question rather than the total, so you know whether the loss is recall, application, practical or timing. Confirm the entry tier and practical route in writing. Get the scheme of work for the rest of the year. Then have the student work past-paper questions with the mark scheme closed, mark honestly afterwards and rewrite the weak answers. None of that costs anything, and it is also what makes any paid hours you do buy go further.

faqs.question: Why do Biology tutoring quotes in the northern emirates rise between January and April?
faqs.answer: Because supply is fixed and demand is not. The number of people in and around Ajman who can teach Extended Biology to examination level does not change during the year, but the number of families wanting them rises sharply once winter mock results come home. By March most competent science tutors in the area are committed through the June series, and the remaining availability is priced accordingly. Booking a weekly slot in October costs less and secures a better tutor than booking the same help in March, which is the strongest practical argument for starting early.

faqs.question: Do you charge for the first Biology session?
faqs.answer: No. The first 50-minute lesson is free, with no card details taken beforehand and no obligation afterwards. It is run as a diagnostic rather than a sample lesson: a spread of questions across topics and command words, one written answer produced and marked live, and a direct opinion about what is actually wrong. You then receive a written plan with a number attached before anything is charged. If the lesson suggests the problem does not need paid hours, that is what the plan will say.

faqs.question: Can one tutor cover 0610 Biology and 0620 Chemistry for the same student?
faqs.answer: Often, and it usually reduces the per-hour figure because one person is filling two slots. The test is whether they have taught both to examination level rather than whether they feel confident in both. Ask which papers they have taught most recently in each, and ask to see how they mark a structured answer in the weaker of the two. Where the honest answer is that they are strong in one and passable in the other, two specialists for fewer total hours is usually the better purchase than one generalist for more.

faqs.question: How much of the 0610 grade is already decided before the written papers?
faqs.answer: Twenty per cent of it, through the practical component, is decided by work done in or about the laboratory rather than in the theory papers. The tier is also fixed in advance, and with it the ceiling on the grade. Everything else is still open. That matters for budgeting: a family discovering in April that the practical paper has not been revised has a fifth of the grade in play and very little time, which is why a block aimed at Paper 5 or Paper 6 in February is one of the most efficient purchases in the whole course.

faqs.question: Which of the twenty-one 0610 topics should we pay for first?
faqs.answer: Whichever the mock script says, and the script usually says one of four. Inheritance and genetics, because it carries method marks and rewards being taught properly. Enzymes and biological molecules, because the vocabulary recurs across digestion, respiration and photosynthesis. Transport and gas exchange, because the explanation chains are long and partial answers score poorly. And the practical skills behind Paper 5 or 6. Ecology and human influence usually comes last in the teaching order and is largely recall, which makes it the worst use of a specialist hour and the best use of a weekend.

faqs.question: Does a family in Ajman pay more because few Biology specialists live nearby?
faqs.answer: For in-home tuition, yes, and noticeably. A small emirate with a small private-school set has few people who have taught Extended 0610 through to a series, and anyone travelling to a villa in Al Mowaihat or a tower in Emirates City is pricing the drive into the hour whether the invoice itemises it or not. Online delivery removes that constraint, because the pool is no longer bounded by a driving radius. That is the main reason the format exists here rather than a claim that screens teach better than rooms.

faqs.question: Is a monthly Biology package better value than paying per session?
faqs.answer: Only after you divide. Packages advertised in this market include AED 799 a month for eight online sessions, which works out near AED 100 an hour, and AED 1,599 to 1,799 a month for four two-hour in-home sessions, which lands closer to AED 200 to 225. A package is good value when the sessions will genuinely be used and bad value in a month with half-term, travel or examinations in it. Ask what happens to unused sessions before agreeing, and ask whether marking is included or billed separately.

faqs.question: What should a 0610 quote tell me before I accept it?
faqs.answer: Six things. Which tier and which practical route it assumes. How many sessions, over how many weeks. Whether marked written work is included or only explanation. Who the tutor is and which papers they have taught most recently. What happens if the match is wrong after two sessions. And what the total comes to in AED rather than per hour. A quote missing any of those is not yet a quote, and a provider who will not put them in writing has told you something useful.

faqs.question: Does a Biology tutor charging an Ajman family need a UAE permit?
faqs.answer: Individuals providing private tuition in the UAE need a private tuition work permit from MoHRE, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023. It is granted free of charge for two years, and eligible categories include teachers registered in government or private schools, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. MoHRE's service page lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time. Those tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws. It is a reasonable question to ask anybody before you pay them.

intro.heading: Why the 0450 case study decides the grade, and what tutoring actually changes
paragraphs: Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies 0450 is assessed by two papers of equal weight, each 80 marks and each 1 hour 30 minutes. The first is short-answer and data-response work across the syllabus. The second is built on a case study: a described business, its numbers, its problems, and a set of questions that only award full marks when the answer is clearly about that business rather than about businesses in general. Half the grade therefore sits in a paper that cannot be revised by rereading notes, which is why so many Ajman parents start looking for help in Year 11 after a mock that felt unfair.

It was not unfair. The usual script shows a student who knows the content well, defines terms accurately, explains concepts correctly, and never once mentions the firm named in the booklet. That pattern loses application marks on almost every question and evaluation marks on the longer ones, and the total can land a full grade below what the student's knowledge deserves. It is also the most fixable problem in the subject, because nothing has to be learned — a habit has to be replaced, and habits respond to repetition under time pressure.

The second recurring pattern is arithmetic avoidance. The finance section expects students to calculate and interpret: gross and net profit margins, break-even output, working capital, simple ratios. These are low-difficulty, high-certainty marks, and they are skipped by students who have decided that Business Studies is an essay subject. A tutor's first job is often to make the student attempt every calculation question in a past paper, correctly or otherwise, and then show them how predictable the method is. That single change frequently moves a grade boundary on its own.

On cost, this page takes the opposite approach to most tutoring sites: it starts from the cheapest credible option and works up, so you can see exactly what each extra hundred dirhams buys. Tutopiya advertises from AED 33 to AED 52 an hour and EdFlik from AED 45 to AED 65. Unitors publishes AED 150 as its IGCSE starting rate. TutorChase quotes AED 270, and Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 figures put examined-subject specialists between AED 200 and AED 450 and above, with named premium tutors such as BartyED at AED 650. In-home visiting in this market is quoted at AED 180 to AED 500 once driving is included. Those are the providers' and the survey's own numbers, reproduced with their attribution rather than presented as ours.

Delivery is online. IB Gram matches your child to a 0450 specialist and runs the session over live video, with the case study booklet and the mark scheme open on a shared screen so an answer can be rewritten in front of the student. We do not visit homes anywhere in the UAE — in-home tuition is something IB Gram offers only in India. For a case-study subject that costs nothing: the entire working material is a document, and a document is easier to annotate jointly on a screen than across a dining table.

ajman/cambridge-igcse-business-studies-0.programmesIntro: 0450 is usually chosen in Year 9 as part of an options block and it sets up three different post-16 routes. Ajman families should know which one before the option form is signed, because two of the three are not available inside the emirate and one of them changes the subject entirely.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies (0450)
programmes.description: Two years, six syllabus sections, two equally weighted papers and no coursework. The subject is often described as accessible, and the content genuinely is. What is not accessible is the case-study paper's demand that every answer be rooted in the specific business described, with a recommendation at the end of the longer questions rather than a balanced shrug.
programmes.countryNote: Ajman's private schools tend to run 0450 as a popular option with large sets, which is good for timetabling and difficult for individual feedback. A set of thirty-five means the teacher cannot mark every student's case-study attempt in detail every fortnight, and that gap in individual marking is precisely what families here end up buying privately.

programmes.name: Cambridge International AS and A Level Business (9609)
programmes.description: The direct continuation. AS introduces strategic analysis and more demanding quantitative work; A Level adds business strategy and change management. Students who built the application habit at 0450 arrive ready. Students who did not spend their first term learning to write about a specific organisation, which is a harder correction at sixth form than it is in Year 10.
programmes.countryNote: Not every Ajman school offers 9609, so a student intending to continue may be applying to Sharjah or Dubai for Years 12 and 13. The predicted grade from 0450 does real work on that application, which means the Year 11 series in this emirate is an admissions document as well as a qualification.

programmes.name: IB Diploma Programme Business Management
programmes.description: A different subject wearing a similar name. The Diploma course assesses through examination papers plus an internal assessment: a research project on a real organisation, written to published criteria. The analytical tools overlap with 0450, but the writing conventions, the research expectation and the referencing standard are all new, and the internal assessment must be the student's own work throughout.
programmes.countryNote: Ajman Academy is the emirate's IB route, so the Diploma option locally is a single destination rather than a choice. Students we support moving from 0450 into Diploma Business Management usually need help with research framing and criterion language rather than with business content, which they already have.

programmes.name: Pearson BTEC Business qualifications
programmes.description: The coursework-weighted alternative taken by students who perform better across sustained assignments than in a 90-minute paper. Assessment is largely internal, with external units in some pathways. It suits a student whose 0450 content knowledge is solid and whose exam performance keeps undershooting it for reasons of timing or anxiety rather than understanding.
programmes.countryNote: BTEC provision in the northern emirates is limited and concentrated in a small number of centres, so it is worth checking availability early rather than assuming it exists as a fallback. Where it is available, a 0450 grade remains the main evidence a centre will look at.
