sections.heading: The 0450 case study is half the grade and it is not a memory test
paragraphs: Paper 2 presents a business. It has a name, a size, a legal form, a market, some numbers and a problem. Every question that follows is about that business, and the mark scheme awards application marks for answers that could only have been written about it. A student who writes a textbook-perfect paragraph on methods of motivation, without once referring to the firm's staff turnover figure or its shift pattern, has written an answer that cannot score full marks no matter how accurate the theory is.

This is the single most common failure in Ajman scripts, and it is worth understanding why it happens. Students are taught content in Year 10 and tested on content. The case-study paper arrives and asks them to use content as a tool on a specific problem, which is a different cognitive task with no warning attached. Most students have simply never practised it. The fix is mechanical: take one question, underline every fact in the case that could possibly be relevant, and refuse to write a sentence that does not use one of them.

The longer questions add a second demand on top of application. They expect a judgement — a recommendation with a reason and a condition under which it would change. Students trained to write balanced arguments stop at balance, offering two sides and no verdict, which caps the mark in the evaluation band. Learning to finish an answer is a two-session job, not a two-term job, and it is usually the fastest grade movement available in the subject.

None of this requires new content knowledge, which is why 0450 responds so well to short, targeted blocks rather than year-long courses. A student six weeks from the paper with solid content and poor technique is in a much better position than one with the reverse problem, and should be told so rather than sold a longer plan than they need.

sections.heading: Both 0450 papers, component by component
paragraphs: The published assessment structure for Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies 0450 is symmetrical and easy to plan against: two papers, 80 marks each, 1 hour 30 minutes each, 50 per cent each. There is no coursework and no practical component, so nothing is banked before the exam series starts. The full syllabus and assessment overview sit on the Cambridge International website under code 0450, and reading the assessment objectives once tells a parent more about where marks go than any revision guide summary.

Paper 1 is short-answer and data-response. It samples widely across the six syllabus sections, which means a gap anywhere shows up somewhere. The questions are usually worth two to six marks, time pressure is moderate, and the main losses come from one-word answers to questions that asked for an explanation, and from definitions given approximately when the mark scheme wants precision. This paper rewards disciplined revision and is the one a motivated student can genuinely improve alone.

Paper 2 is the case study, and the time pressure is real. Students must read the material, locate the relevant evidence, and produce answers that escalate from identification through analysis to a recommendation. The arithmetic of the paper matters: at 80 marks in 90 minutes, roughly a mark a minute, there is no spare time for a long introduction or for rereading the case three times. Timed practice is therefore not optional revision; it is the only way the pacing becomes survivable.

sections.heading: How many hours a 0450 grade movement actually takes
paragraphs: Parents ask how many sessions are needed and are usually given an answer designed to sell a package. The honest answer depends on which of three problems the student has, and a marked paper identifies it in ten minutes. Problem one is missing content, which takes the longest. Problem two is case-study technique, which is fast. Problem three is pacing and finishing, which is faster still and sometimes resolves in a single session once the student sees the mark-per-minute arithmetic.

The table below gives working estimates with the AED range attached, calculated from the specialist and qualified bands published earlier on this page rather than from an internal price list. They assume one 60-minute session per booking and homework completed between sessions. A student who does not do the between-session work needs roughly double the hours for the same movement, which is the real reason some plans overrun rather than any failure of teaching.

Two honest caveats belong with any estimate of this kind. No tutor can promise a grade, and anyone quoting a specific improvement should be treated with scepticism rather than relief. What can be promised is evidence: a marked script every fortnight, a per-question record of application and evaluation marks, and a visible trend. If that trend is flat after six sessions the plan is wrong and should change, which is a conversation worth having at session six rather than session twenty. The second caveat is that the hours below buy teaching time only; the reading, the attempts and the corrections happen between sessions, and a plan with no homework in it is a plan with no mechanism.

sections.heading: 0450 or 0455: the option choice Ajman commerce students get wrong
paragraphs: Every year a number of students in this emirate choose Business Studies expecting Economics, or Economics expecting Business Studies, usually because an option form described both in one line. The two subjects share a vocabulary and almost nothing else. 0450 is about how a single organisation is run and is assessed half on a case study. 0455 is about why markets and economies behave as they do, and is assessed on a multiple-choice paper worth 30 per cent plus a written paper worth 70 per cent containing a data-response extract.

The practical distinction that matters to a fourteen-year-old is this. 0455 rewards students who like diagrams and abstract argument and who are comfortable being told that the answer depends on elasticity. 0450 rewards students who like concrete situations and can make a decision about a real firm with incomplete information. A student who finds abstraction uncomfortable will usually produce better work in 0450; a student who finds specific detail fiddly will usually prefer 0455. Neither is the easier subject in general, and both are genuinely harder than their reputations suggest.

Taking both is a reasonable choice and a common one in Ajman's commerce streams, provided the revision is sequenced rather than merged. The overlap — profit, markets, government intervention, international trade — is real but is examined in different formats, so content learned once still has to be practised twice. Where a family is paying for help in both, one tutor covering both subjects is usually better value and definitely less confusing than two tutors, because the sequencing decision gets made once.

sections.heading: The Cambridge calendar, counted backwards from the paper
paragraphs: Almost no competitor page in this market names an exam session, let alone a deadline, which is strange given that deadlines are what actually constrain a tutoring plan. Cambridge International runs IGCSE and O Level exams in a June series and a November series, with Primary and Lower Secondary Checkpoint tests in March, May and October. Entries close long before the papers are sat, and the entry decision is made by the school rather than the family.

Take the November series, because for most 0450 students it is the next sitting a decision can still affect. The papers fall in October and November on the timetable for the centre's zone, the final entry closes in the summer, forecast grades go to Cambridge through the centre before the papers are sat, and the result arrives in January. Read that backwards and the squeeze is visible: a student who wants to improve on an August grade has to commit over the holidays, not in the new academic year, because by the time term settles the entry has closed. The June series has the same shape shifted half a year — entry in the spring, papers in May and June, result in August. One caution about what a search for Cambridge key dates returns, since it is where this page originally went wrong: the February and early-March sitting that appears with its own published deadlines is offered to candidates in India only, and none of those dates apply to a child sitting 0450 in Ajman.

One further detail that catches families who have moved from another country. Cambridge allocates every centre to one of six administrative zones, states that it is essential to use the correct version of the timetable for your zone, and says it cannot accept responsibility for candidates who miss an exam after the wrong zone timetable was used. Ask your school's exams officer which zone it sits in and get the timetable from the school, not from a search result. For Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, where a school uses that board instead, exams run in May/June and November and provisional timetables are published ahead of each series, so the live official timetable is the only one worth planning against.

sections.heading: Arabic, Islamic Education and Social Studies: the squeeze around 0450
paragraphs: Parents new to UAE schooling are regularly surprised by how full the week is, and it is not the international curriculum doing it. Private schools here teach Arabic, social studies and Islamic studies alongside whichever curriculum they are licensed for, and the federal position is that private schools are not obliged to follow a specific curriculum beyond Arabic language, social studies and Islamic studies, while adhering to the Ministry's general regulations. Those subjects are timetabled lessons with their own assessment, not enrichment.

KHDA's published mandatory-subjects guidance for Dubai sets out the mechanics in detail, and it is the clearest public description of how this works anywhere in the UAE. Instructional time is calculated on a 40-minute lesson unit, schools may vary lesson length provided total weekly time is met, and it is advised that any mandatory subject lesson runs at least 25 minutes. Separate classes are required for Arabs and non-Arabs in Arabic as a first language, Islamic Education and Social Studies, with combined classes strictly prohibited because the curriculum expectations and language of instruction differ. Using different or additional content without prior Ministry of Education permission is prohibited.

The consequence for a 0450 plan in Ajman is arithmetic rather than principle. A Year 11 student carrying eight or nine examined subjects plus mandatory Arabic, Islamic Education and Social Studies has fewer free evenings than the option block implies, and the free ones arrive late because of the commute. Timed case-study practice needs an uninterrupted 90-minute window, which in most Ajman households exists at the weekend rather than midweek. Planning the practice into Saturday morning and keeping weekday sessions for marking and correction is what makes the plan survive to February.

sections.heading: Ramadan, the Ajman evening, and when a 0450 session actually happens
paragraphs: A tutoring plan that ignores the UAE calendar fails in March. Ramadan shortens the school day, moves family routines into the evening, and makes a 6pm session impractical for many households while making a post-Iftar slot genuinely workable. Because Ramadan moves earlier each year against the Gregorian calendar, it can land close to a spring exam series, which is exactly when a Year 11 student needs their heaviest timed practice. The plan has to be built for that in advance rather than renegotiated during it.

In practice, families in Ajman handle this in one of three ways. Some move sessions to after Iftar, typically 9pm or later, which works well for older students and badly for younger ones. Some shift the whole plan to weekend mornings for the month and accept slower progress midweek. Some front-load: they put the heavy timed-paper work into January and early February so that Ramadan weeks can be lighter consolidation rather than new ground. The third approach is the one that holds up best when the series is close.

The rest of the Ajman calendar matters less dramatically but still matters. Children attending Sharjah schools follow Sharjah's term dates, so siblings in the same house can be on holiday in different weeks. Summer in this emirate removes evening traffic and opens up afternoon slots that do not exist in term time, which makes July and August unusually efficient for closing content gaps before a Year 11 run. None of this is a reason to delay starting, but all of it is a reason to write the plan around the year rather than around a generic twelve-week template.

sections.heading: Booking a 0450 tutor, and the honest version of availability
paragraphs: Getting started takes one message and no payment. Send the school, the year group, and either the last marked Business Studies paper or a photograph of a recent case-study attempt. That attempt is the diagnostic: it reveals in minutes whether the issue is application, evaluation, calculation, pacing or genuine content gaps, and those five problems need completely different plans with completely different costs. A free trial lesson follows with the specialist who would teach the course, and no fee is taken until after it has happened.

Session times are built around your week. For most Ajman households that means a weekday slot at 7.30pm or later, or a weekend morning when a timed paper can actually be sat without interruption. Rescheduling with reasonable notice is free, because a plan that charges a family for one bad traffic evening is a plan that quietly ends in March. Sessions are 60 minutes as standard, and a 90-minute slot can be used when a full timed paper is the point of the session.

Then the disclosure that most platforms skip. Business Studies specialists are not always free at the hour you want, and the weeks before a main series are the tightest in the year. When that is the case we say so, and offer a different time with the specialist you asked for, an available tutor whose 0450 experience is described precisely enough for you to judge it, or a dated place on the waiting list. Nobody is presented as a subject specialist who is not one. Tuition is delivered as one-to-one lessons over live video, so the pool is national rather than whoever happens to live within a short drive of Ajman.

process.description: Sixty minutes with the tutor who would actually teach the course. They work through one real case-study question so you can watch the marking happen rather than read a description of it. No payment is taken before this lesson.

process.description: You receive the number of sessions, the order of work, and the date the block finishes. Plans with an end point get reviewed deliberately; open-ended arrangements drift, and drifting is what makes tutoring expensive rather than the hourly rate.

process.title: Fortnightly timed paper, marked to the scheme
process.description: One case study under exam conditions every two weeks, marked against the published Cambridge scheme with application and evaluation marks recorded separately. That record is the evidence you use to judge whether to continue, change or stop.

process.description: If the marked evidence has not moved by the sixth session, the plan is wrong and we change it. That might mean a different focus, a different tutor, or telling you the student needs less help than you were prepared to buy.

whyPoints.description: This page starts at the cheapest advertised option in the UAE market and works upward, with each rung's source named. You can see what each extra band is meant to buy, and you can take those numbers to any other provider and ask them to justify theirs.

whyPoints.description: 0450 technique only changes under time pressure, so the plan is built on timed papers marked to the published scheme. A tutor who talks about the case-study paper without producing a marked script every fortnight is selling the cheap product.

whyPoints.title: Finance calculations are compulsory in every block
whyPoints.description: The quickest reliable marks in 0450 are the ones most students skip. Every cycle includes attempting the calculation questions, right or wrong, because avoidance is a habit and habits only break through repetition.

whyPoints.description: Cambridge's published key dates sit in a table on this page, including the entry deadline that falls months before the paper. Deadlines shape a plan more than ambition does, and almost nobody else in this market publishes them.

whyPoints.description: Masfout and Al Rawda are not scheduling equivalents, Sharjah term dates run beside Ajman's in the same household, and Ramadan lands near the spring series. The plan is built around that rather than around a template.

faqs.question: Is Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies 0450 easier than Economics 0455?
faqs.answer: They are differently hard rather than ranked. 0450's content is more concrete and more quickly understood, but half the grade sits in a case-study paper that penalises general answers, so a student who revises by rereading notes can know the subject well and still underperform. 0455 carries more abstraction and diagram work, with a 30 per cent multiple-choice paper where recognition errors cost marks quietly. The better question is which suits your child: concrete decisions about one firm, or abstract reasoning about markets. Students who find abstraction uncomfortable usually do better work in 0450.

faqs.question: What is the 0450 case study paper and how is it marked?
faqs.answer: Paper 2 is built around one described business: its size, legal form, market, figures and a problem it faces. It carries 80 marks in 1 hour 30 minutes and is worth half the qualification. The mark scheme awards application marks for answers clearly rooted in that specific business, and the highest-tariff questions additionally require evaluation — a recommendation supported by a reason and a condition. A correct, well-written paragraph of general theory with no reference to the firm cannot reach the top band. That is why timed practice with a marked script matters more here than in any other part of the course.

faqs.question: How much should an Ajman family budget for Business Studies 0450 tutoring?
faqs.answer: Start from the published UAE market rather than from a single quote. The cheapest advertised rates are Tutopiya from AED 33 to AED 52 an hour and EdFlik from AED 45 to AED 65. Qualified one-to-one online teaching sits at AED 150 to AED 300, with Unitors publishing AED 150 for IGCSE. Examined-subject specialists run AED 200 to AED 450 and above per Bestimate's 2026 figures, and TutorChase quotes AED 270. For a technique-focused block of five or six sessions, that is roughly AED 750 to AED 2,700 in total. Content repair across two or more sections costs considerably more because it takes considerably longer.

faqs.question: Which 0450 topics do Year 11 students lose the most marks on?
faqs.answer: Finance is the biggest avoidable loss: break-even, margins, working capital and ratio interpretation carry predictable marks and are regularly skipped by students who decided the subject was essay-based. Second is anything requiring application in the operations and people sections, where textbook answers about motivation or quality control appear with no reference to the case. Third is the external-influences section, which students revise last and understand least. Across all three the pattern is the same: the content is known, the question's actual demand was not met. That is why a marked script diagnoses a 0450 problem faster than any topic checklist.

faqs.question: Does Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies 0450 involve much maths?
faqs.answer: More than its reputation suggests, and the arithmetic is straightforward rather than advanced. Students need percentage change, ratio, simple rearrangement and careful reading of a table: enough to calculate gross and net profit margins, break-even output, working capital and basic performance ratios, and then to say what the number means. Interpretation carries marks alongside the calculation, so a correct figure with no comment is a half-finished answer. A student comfortable with Extended Mathematics 0580 has all the technique required. A student weak in percentages loses 0450 marks that look like business marks but are not.

faqs.question: Can my child take 0450 and 0455 in the same exam series?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is a common combination in Ajman's commerce streams. The practical issue is revision collision rather than content conflict: the two syllabuses share vocabulary around profit, markets, government intervention and international trade, but they examine it in completely different formats, so shared knowledge still needs separate practice. Where a family pays for help in both, one tutor covering the pair is usually better value and definitely clearer, because the sequencing is decided once. Two tutors working independently tend to schedule their heaviest demands in the same fortnight, which is how a workable plan becomes an unworkable one.

faqs.question: How long before the exam should 0450 tutoring start?
faqs.answer: It depends on which problem the marked paper shows. Pacing problems can move in two or three sessions. Case-study technique usually needs five or six weeks to become automatic under time pressure. Genuine content gaps across two or more syllabus sections need two to three terms, which means starting in Year 10 rather than after the Year 11 mocks. The expensive mistake is the February start: by then the same money buys a third of the contact time it would have bought in September, and the gaps have compounded. A free trial lesson in the autumn term costs nothing and settles the question with evidence.

faqs.question: Why does the same tutor charge a different hourly rate for a two-hour booking?
faqs.answer: Usually because the hourly figure is absorbing travel and setup that does not double when the lesson does. In this market in-home packages are commonly sold as four two-hour sessions a month at AED 1,599 to AED 1,799, which reads as a lower hourly rate than eight one-hour sessions at AED 799 a month online while costing roughly twice as much in total. Compare monthly commitments, not hourly rates. For 0450 specifically, two separate 60-minute sessions usually beat one two-hour block, because case-study technique improves through repeated short cycles of attempt, marking and correction.

faqs.question: Are there group classes for IGCSE Business Studies in Ajman?
faqs.answer: Tuition centres in the northern emirates do run group classes, and they are the cheapest option per student for covering content. No consistent per-student hourly rate is published across this market, so you have to ask each centre directly and ask what group size the price assumes. The trade-off is specific to 0450: group teaching handles the six syllabus sections well and handles individual case-study marking badly, because marking 80-mark scripts for eight students every fortnight is not something a group rate funds. Many families use a centre for content and buy individual marking separately.

faqs.question: Do Ajman schools enter candidates for the November Business Studies series?
faqs.answer: Some do and some do not, and the decision belongs to the school rather than to Cambridge or to a family. Cambridge International runs IGCSE exams in both a June and a November series, so the option exists in principle. Two things need checking with the exams officer before planning around it: whether your school enters for the session at all, and the entry deadline, which falls months before the papers. Entries for the November papers close in the summer, within weeks of June results being published, so a decision that feels like it belongs to the coming academic year has in practice to be taken over the holidays.

faqs.question: Is the 0450 case study released to students before the exam?
faqs.answer: Do not assume it is. Arrangements differ between syllabuses and have changed over time, so the only reliable answer for your child's series comes from the school's exams officer and from the current syllabus document on the Cambridge International website. What is consistent is the skill required: locating relevant evidence in supplied material quickly and using it in every answer. That skill is built by working through past case studies under timed conditions, whether or not the material arrives in advance. We link to official papers and syllabuses rather than reproducing or supplying them, because they are Cambridge's copyright.

faqs.question: How do we check that a Business Studies tutor has actually taught 0450?
faqs.answer: Ask three specific questions and listen for specific answers. First, what are the two papers worth and how long is each? Anyone teaching the syllabus knows it is 80 marks and 90 minutes twice, at 50 per cent each. Second, what separates a mid-band answer from a top-band one on an evaluation question? The answer should mention application to the named business and a supported recommendation. Third, can you see a marked script, with the student's name removed? Vague answers to any of the three mean the person knows business, not 0450. For UAE-based tutors, also ask to see the MoHRE private tuition work permit.

faqs.question: Is a monthly tutoring package better value than paying per session?
faqs.answer: Only if the monthly commitment matches what the student actually needs. The packages visible in this market are AED 799 a month for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to AED 1,799 a month for four two-hour in-home sessions. For a student who needs twenty sessions of content repair, a monthly rate is sensible. For a student who needs five sessions of case-study technique, it is a subscription to something already finished. Ask what happens at the end of the month, whether unused sessions carry over, and what notice is required to stop. A block with a stated end date avoids the question entirely.

faqs.question: Can lessons move to post-Iftar timing during Ramadan in Ajman?
faqs.answer: Yes, and for Year 11 students it is often the better slot. School days shorten during Ramadan and household routines move into the evening, so a 6pm session stops working while a 9pm or later one becomes genuinely practical. Because Ramadan moves earlier each year against the Gregorian calendar it can fall close to a spring exam series, so the sensible approach is front-loading: put heavy timed-paper work into January and early February and use the Ramadan weeks for lighter consolidation. Agreeing that shape in advance works better than renegotiating the timetable in week one of the month.

faqs.question: Does my child need Business Studies 0450 for a business degree in the UAE?
faqs.answer: Generally no. Universities here set entry requirements around overall qualification profile, English and mathematics rather than around a specific IGCSE option, and separately the Ministry of Education equivalency process for British-track students requires five accredited subjects at IGCSE or GCSE at no less than grade E or 3, excluding Arabic and Islamic education, plus one A Level at E or two AS Levels at E. Those requirements are published; verify them on the Ministry's own channels before relying on any summary, including this one. Nobody should tell you tutoring is required for equivalency or admission, because it is not.

ajman/cambridge-igcse-business-studies-0.closingHeading: Send one case-study attempt and we will tell you what it needs
ajman/cambridge-igcse-business-studies-0.closingBody: For Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies 0450 the quickest honest diagnosis comes from a single marked case-study answer. Send it with your child's school and year group and a 0450 specialist will tell you which of the five usual problems it shows — pacing, application, evaluation, calculation or genuine content gaps — and roughly how many sessions each one takes. A free trial lesson with that tutor follows, and the rate bands on this page are published with their sources so you can weigh any plan against the market. Lessons run one-to-one over live video at times that fit an Ajman week.

ajman/cambridge-igcse-chemistry-0620-tut.tutorsIntro: The tutors below teach Cambridge IGCSE Chemistry 0620 at both tiers: the Core route through Papers 1 and 3, the Extended route through Papers 2 and 4, with the practical component alongside. Slots run on Gulf Standard Time, late enough for Ajman households where a parent drives back from Sharjah or Dubai.

intro.heading: Chemistry is three subjects on one paper, and the strands fail separately
paragraphs: A chemistry mark is an average of three unrelated performances, which is why it is such poor guidance about what to do next. Physical chemistry is arithmetic with chemical rules attached: moles, concentrations, yields, energy changes, rates. Inorganic chemistry is pattern recognition plus a body of precise observations that have to be reproduced in the examiner's words. Organic chemistry is a set of families, reactions and conditions, and it sits at the end of nearly every scheme of work, which means it is usually the part a January mock never tested.

A student can be strong in two of those and weak in one and come home with a grade 5. A student weak in all three has a different and longer problem. The report card cannot distinguish them, and nor can a percentage, because a percentage averages across the very division that would tell you what to buy. So the work here starts by scoring a marked script strand by strand: how many marks were available in each, how many were taken, and what the losses in each strand had in common.

The output is usually surprisingly specific. A typical Ajman Extended script arrives with inorganic recall in reasonable shape, physical chemistry collapsing somewhere inside the mole chain, and organic chemistry blank because it had not been taught at the time of the mock. That is three different instructions: leave inorganic alone for now, drill the calculation chain line by line, and schedule organic for when the school reaches it so the tuition does not arrive before the teaching does.

0620 also puts a fifth of the grade in a practical component, taken as either a practical test in the school laboratory or a written alternative at a desk. Confirm which route the school entered your child for, along with the component structure and timings for the exam year, at cambridgeinternational.org. Qualitative analysis sits inside that component and inside the theory papers too, and it is the clearest example in the whole syllabus of marks awarded for exact wording rather than for understanding.

What follows is built around what a marked paper can show. There is a line-by-line reading of the mole chain, an account of how equations earn and lose credit, a reference table of the qualitative tests and the observations the scheme expects, and a strand scoreboard a parent can actually keep. Tuition is delivered one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time; IB Gram does not send tutors to addresses in Ajman, because home visiting is a service it runs only in India. Any in-home rate quoted here is the market's published price, included so the comparison is honest. One more thing worth settling early: whether the entry is Core or Extended, because the tier caps what any amount of tuition can award.

ajman/cambridge-igcse-chemistry-0620-tut.programmesIntro: Chemistry at 0620 is a stage whose marks are distributed unevenly across three strands, and each stage of the route redistributes them again. The notes below say what each stage demands and what counts as evidence it is in place.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE Chemistry 0620
programmes.description: A two-year course assessed by a multiple-choice paper, a theory paper and a practical component, with the first two set by tier. The twelve topic areas run from states of matter, atomic structure and stoichiometry through electrochemistry, energetics, rates and equilibria, acids and bases, the Periodic Table and metals, to environmental chemistry, organic chemistry and experimental techniques. There is no coursework. Confirm the structure and timings for your child's exam year at cambridgeinternational.org.
programmes.countryNote: Ajman campuses vary widely in laboratory access, and chemistry is the subject where that shows up most. Qualitative analysis is learned far better with a test tube in hand, and a cohort that has seen few precipitates will reproduce the observations from a textbook rather than from memory of the colour. That is a real disadvantage and it is also entirely fixable on paper, because the examiner is marking the words rather than the experience.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE Co-ordinated Sciences
programmes.description: The combined route several Ajman and Sharjah schools run in place of three separate sciences. It covers chemistry to a reduced depth alongside physics and biology and produces one or two grades rather than three, with a practical component spanning all three subjects. A student on this route is not sitting 0620, and tuition built on 0620 past papers will cover material that is not on their specification.
programmes.countryNote: Read the subject line on the statement of entry. In Ajman households with children at two different campuses this check is worth doing per child, because one may be on separate sciences and the other on a co-ordinated route, and the revision materials for the two are not interchangeable even though the chemistry topics have the same names.

programmes.name: IB Diploma Chemistry, and A Level Chemistry
programmes.description: Where a strong Extended 0620 grade leads. Both courses assume the mole concept as fluent working language rather than as a topic, and both open with bonding and energetics at a depth that expects the IGCSE treatment to be secure. A candidate who passed 0620 while avoiding the calculation strand meets that gap in the first weeks of Year 12, and the catch-up costs considerably more than securing it in Year 11 would have.
programmes.countryNote: No IB session or results date is published on this page, because the IB's own site blocks automated checking; confirm any Diploma date with the school's coordinator or on ibo.org. UAE schools sit the May session, and the internal deadlines inside a school fall months earlier, which is why the calculation strand is the one worth funding properly before Year 11 ends.

ajman/cambridge-igcse-chemistry-0620-tut.subjectsIntro: The twelve topic areas of 0620 distribute across the three strands, and the evidence that each is secure differs. The notes below give what secure work looks like and the error that recurs when it is missing.

subjects.name: States of matter and separation techniques
subjects.description: Kinetic particle theory, changes of state, diffusion, and the separation methods including filtration, crystallisation, distillation and chromatography. Secure answers describe particle arrangement and movement separately. The recurring loss is a change-of-state explanation that mentions energy without mentioning the forces between particles being overcome.

subjects.name: Atoms, elements and bonding
subjects.description: Atomic structure, isotopes, ionic, covalent and metallic bonding, and the properties that follow from each. Secure work draws a dot-and-cross diagram with charges shown on ions and the correct number of electrons in every shell. Marks disappear when a property is stated without being linked to the structure that causes it.

subjects.name: Stoichiometry and the mole
subjects.description: Relative masses, the mole, molar mass, concentration, reacting-mass calculations, limiting reagents, percentage yield and purity, and gas volumes at Extended. This is the strand that decides most Extended grades, and it is lost at identifiable steps rather than wholesale, which is why it is marked line by line in sessions rather than as a final answer.

subjects.name: Electrochemistry and electrolysis
subjects.description: Electrolysis of molten and aqueous compounds, the products at each electrode, inert and active electrodes, and half equations at Extended. Secure work identifies the ions present before predicting anything. The usual loss is a correct product named at the wrong electrode, which is a definitions problem rather than a chemistry one and takes a single session.

subjects.name: Chemical energetics and rates of reaction
subjects.description: Exothermic and endothermic changes, energy-level diagrams, bond breaking and making, and the factors affecting rate including catalysts and surface area. Secure answers on rate refer to collision frequency and to the proportion of collisions with sufficient energy. Explanations that say only that particles move faster earn part of the mark and lose the rest.

subjects.name: Acids, bases, salts and titration
subjects.description: Acid and base reactions, pH, indicators, neutralisation, preparing soluble and insoluble salts, and titration method and calculation. Secure work on salt preparation gives the full method in order, including the step that removes excess reagent. Titration marks are lost on the reading precision and the concordant-results requirement rather than on the arithmetic.

subjects.name: The Periodic Table and metals
subjects.description: Group properties, trends down a group and across a period, transition elements, the reactivity series, extraction of metals and rusting. Secure answers explain a trend using electron shells rather than restating the trend. The reactivity series is pure recall and is among the cheapest content in the syllabus to secure in a single session.

subjects.name: Chemistry of the environment and industrial processes
subjects.description: Water treatment, air pollutants and their sources, fertilisers, and the industrial processes named in the syllabus with their conditions. The conditions are recall and are examined as specific values and reagents, so an answer that describes a process correctly without its conditions scores partially. Late in most schemes, and therefore frequently thin in a mock.

subjects.name: Organic chemistry: families, reactions and conditions
subjects.description: Fuels and fractional distillation, alkanes, alkenes, alcohols and carboxylic acids, addition and substitution, fermentation and the catalytic route, polymers and macromolecules at Extended. Secure work writes a reaction with its conditions attached. This strand is almost always taught last, which means a January mock mark is not evidence about it at all.

subjects.name: Experimental techniques and chemical analysis
subjects.description: Measurement and apparatus choice, purity and melting points, chromatography interpretation, and the qualitative tests for cations, anions and gases. The qualitative tests are a fixed, learnable body of text where the examiner expects particular words, and the marks are awarded for the observation rather than for the conclusion a student draws from it.

ajman/cambridge-igcse-chemistry-0620-tut.regionsIntro: What differs across Ajman for a chemistry family is how much laboratory time the school can give and whether written work gets produced at home. These notes are about those, because both show up in the practical component.

regions.name: Al Nuaimiya
regions.note: Central Ajman, home to several of the emirate's longest-running campuses with the most settled science departments. Candidates here are more likely to have seen the standard precipitates, which changes how qualitative analysis is taught: recognition first, wording second.

regions.name: Al Rashidiya
regions.note: Older Ajman near the commercial strip. Apartment living predominates, so the constraint is a quiet desk rather than a commute, and chemistry sessions that require written equations need a surface and a decent light more than they need space.

regions.name: Al Jurf
regions.note: Mixed residential near the university area, with many households running children across different curricula. A child on a co-ordinated science route and a sibling on separate chemistry need different papers, and only the entry documents settle which is which.

regions.name: Al Mowaihat
regions.note: Inland villa communities with long school runs. Students here arrive home late, and the mole chain is the worst possible content to attempt with a tired student, so calculation work is better placed early in a session than at the end of one.

regions.name: Al Rawda
regions.note: Established villa and apartment districts with school choices spread across Ajman and Sharjah. Where a child attends a Sharjah campus, that school sits under the Sharjah Private Education Authority, which approves curricula and assessment methods in that emirate.

regions.name: Al Yasmeen

sections.heading: The mole chain, read line by line the way it is marked
paragraphs: Most chemistry calculations in 0620 are the same chain in different clothing. A mass or a volume and a concentration go in, moles come out, a ratio from the balanced equation converts those moles to moles of something else, and then a mass, a volume or a concentration comes back out. Partial credit is awarded along that chain, which means a student who breaks at step three still collects steps one and two, and a student who writes only a final answer collects almost nothing.

Scoring a script this way locates the break precisely. Candidates who cannot start are usually missing molar mass fluency rather than the mole concept. Candidates who start well and fail at the ratio have not used the balanced equation, and often have not balanced it. Candidates who complete the chain and still lose a mark are nearly always losing it on units, on significant figures, or on answering in grams when the question asked for kilograms.

Those three break points need three different fortnights, and none of them is a general weakness in chemistry. The repair for molar mass is arithmetic drill. The repair for the ratio step is a rule written at the top of every answer until it is automatic. The repair for the final-line losses is the cheapest of all: a habit of reading the question's units back before writing the answer. Scoring the chain turns a vague instruction to work on calculations into a specific one.

sections.heading: Equations: balancing, charges and state symbols as separate marks
paragraphs: Equation writing is credited in pieces, and students who treat it as one task lose the pieces they did not notice. A symbol equation earns credit for correct formulae and for being balanced, and those are separable: a correctly balanced equation with a wrong formula collects neither, while correct formulae that are unbalanced collect one. State symbols are credited where the question asks for them and are a common silent omission, particularly in precipitation reactions where they carry the meaning.

Ionic equations at Extended add two more failure points. Charges must be right, and spectator ions must be removed rather than kept, and candidates frequently do one without the other. Half equations in electrolysis are the strictest case: the electrons must appear on the correct side and must balance the charge, and a half equation that is chemically sensible but electronically unbalanced earns nothing even though the chemistry behind it is understood.

The reason this belongs in a plan rather than being left to incidental practice is frequency. Equations appear in stoichiometry, electrolysis, energetics, acids and bases, metals and organic chemistry, which is most of the syllabus. A student who becomes reliable at writing them recovers marks in every one of those topics, so three sessions on equation discipline typically return more than three sessions on any single topic area. There is a diagnostic shortcut here for a parent reading a marked script at home. Find every equation on the paper and check only two things: whether the formulae are right and whether the coefficients balance. If the formulae are wrong, the problem is further back, in bonding and valency, and the equations are a symptom. If the formulae are right and the balancing is not, the repair is a fortnight of drill and nothing more.

sections.heading: Qualitative analysis: the test, the observation, the exact words
paragraphs: Qualitative analysis is the most learnable body of marks in 0620 and the one most often left to intuition. The syllabus sets out tests for cations, anions and gases, and the examiner credits the observation in particular terms: a white precipitate soluble in excess is a different answer from a white precipitate insoluble in excess, and the distinction decides which ion the candidate has identified. A paraphrase that captures the idea without the detail scores less than a sentence a student has learned verbatim.

Two habits recover these marks. The first is separating observation from conclusion. The question usually asks what is seen; a candidate who answers with the name of the ion has skipped the credited part. The second is colour precision. Green, red-brown, light blue and off-white are distinct answers in the scheme, and a student who has never seen the precipitate needs to learn the words rather than guess from a textbook photograph, which is entirely possible and is how most candidates in this market actually learn them.

The table below is a working reference for the standard tests, and it should be checked against the notes for qualitative analysis in the syllabus for your child's exam year at cambridgeinternational.org, because the required set is specified there and is occasionally revised. Cambridge's own documents are referenced and linked rather than reproduced; what appears here is a teaching summary, not a copy of the board's material. For a candidate with limited laboratory time, learning this table to recall is one of the few places in the syllabus where a few hours of memorisation converts almost directly into marks.

sections.heading: The practical component and the titration write-up
paragraphs: A fifth of the 0620 grade sits in the practical component, taken either as a practical test in the school laboratory or as a written alternative at a desk. Both carry the same weight and the school decides which when it enters candidates. Many Ajman families do not know which route applies until a mock arrives in an unfamiliar format, and buying practical preparation before establishing the route is a reliable way to waste a block of sessions.

For the written alternative, almost everything that is marked can be taught at a distance. Apparatus choice and why one measuring instrument suits a volume better than another. Designing a results table before readings are taken, with units in the headings. Describing a method precisely enough to be repeated. Identifying anomalies and saying what to do about them. And the improvement question, which decides a surprising share of this paper and rewards a rehearsed structure rather than invention.

Titration deserves naming separately, because it is where chemistry's practical marks concentrate. The credited points are the reading precision, the concordance requirement across repeats, the use of the mean of concordant titres rather than of all readings, and the calculation that follows. Candidates who understand titration perfectly lose marks by averaging a rough titre in with the accurate ones. That is a write-up rule, not a laboratory skill, and it can be drilled over a shared screen until it is automatic. The same is true of the anomaly question, where the credited answer identifies the reading, says why it is suspect and says what to do with it rather than simply labelling it odd.

sections.heading: Organic chemistry: taught last, examined in full
paragraphs: Organic chemistry is the strand that most distorts a mock result. In nearly every scheme of work it is taught in the final months, so a January mock either omits it or tests a fraction of it, and the mark that comes home is therefore not evidence about a third of the subject. Families read it as a total and plan accordingly, which is how a household ends up paying for revision of content the student already holds while the untaught strand stays untouched.

The strand itself is well suited to short, intense work because it is highly structured. Families of compounds with shared functional groups, a small number of reaction types, and a set of conditions attached to each. Fractional distillation, alkanes and substitution, alkenes and addition with the bromine-water test, alcohols by fermentation and by the catalytic route, carboxylic acids, esters, and polymers and macromolecules at Extended. Each of those is a block with a predictable question shape.

The scheduling consequence matters more than the content advice. Organic work should be timed to arrive with or just after the school's teaching rather than months before it, because taught-then-consolidated retains and consolidated-then-taught does not. For an Ajman family planning a Year 11 budget, that usually means the organic block belongs in the spring rather than in the autumn, and the autumn money is better spent on the calculation strand that everything else depends on. There is one exception worth naming. Where a student intends to take chemistry further, the organic reasoning is worth meeting early even at the cost of some retention, because the Diploma and A Level courses treat functional-group behaviour as assumed language rather than as new content.

sections.heading: A strand scoreboard beats a percentage
paragraphs: The record kept here is a scoreboard rather than a score. For each timed paper, the available marks are divided into physical, inorganic and organic chemistry plus the practical and analysis content, and the student's marks are recorded against each. A single line per paper, four or five numbers, and a date. It takes a few minutes to produce and it answers the question a percentage cannot: which strand moved.

What it typically shows across a term is uneven progress that would be invisible in a total. Physical chemistry climbing steadily because the calculation chain is being drilled. Inorganic flat, because it was already reasonable. Organic rising sharply at the point the school teaches it. A total mark would show a modest, gradual improvement and would tell a family nothing about whether their money was working.

It also makes the uncomfortable conversations possible. If physical chemistry has not moved after six weeks of calculation work, the approach is wrong and should change rather than being funded for longer. If organic is still blank in March, the problem is coverage rather than capability and the honest advice may be to prioritise the two strands that can still be secured. No provider can promise a particular grade, and the scoreboard is what allows a parent to judge the claim for themselves. A last practical note. The scoreboard works only if the papers are comparable, which means timed, at the entered tier, and marked against the published criteria rather than generously. A sympathetically marked paper produces a flattering line and destroys the only record a family has.

sections.heading: The cost of a mark, and how to read the published bands
paragraphs: The most useful way to read a tutoring rate is to divide it by what it is supposed to move. A block of eight sessions aimed at the calculation chain is a defined purchase with a measurable output: the strand score on a timed paper before and after. A nine-month general arrangement is not, which is why the same monthly figure feels expensive in one framing and reasonable in the other. Begin with the block, measure it, and extend only if the number moved.

With that framing, the published bands are easier to place. Budget and university-student online tuition is advertised from roughly AED 45 to 150 an hour, with EdFlik publishing from AED 45 to 65 and Tutopiya from about AED 33 to 52; that band suits routine and homework supervision rather than strand-specific repair. Qualified online subject tutors publish roughly AED 150 to 300, with Unitors listing IGCSE tuition from AED 150, and that is where syllabus-accurate chemistry marking sits. Named IB and IGCSE specialists run AED 200 to 450 and above, with TutorChase publishing AED 270, and premium or examiner-led tuition reaches AED 500 to 650 and above, with BartyED publishing AED 650.

In-home visits run roughly AED 180 to 500 an hour including travel, with Bestimate quoting AED 180 to 350 and independent home tutors quoting AED 200 to 500. On monthly packages, the market shows AED 799 a month for eight online sessions against AED 1,599 to 1,799 a month for four two-hour in-home visits. Every figure here was published by the named provider and collected in October 2026; they are market rates rather than an IB Gram price list, and any provider should be asked for the date and source of its own.

sections.heading: What a chemistry tutor does with school write-ups
paragraphs: 0620 has no coursework, so there is no portfolio for anyone to complete on a student's behalf. What exists is school work: practical write-ups, investigations, problem sets and mocks that a teacher may collect and grade towards a report. The boundary is the same one that governs assessed work throughout the system, and it is worth stating because one operator found in this market sells completed assessed work outright, which is an academic-integrity breach that exposes the student to malpractice proceedings.

A tutor may teach how a titration write-up is structured, work through a parallel calculation that is not the set question, explain why a conclusion does not follow from a set of titres, and mark the student's own work against the published criteria while naming each forfeited mark. A tutor does not produce the write-up a student hands in. In a strand-scored plan this is structural rather than decorative: a scoreboard built from somebody else's chemistry measures nothing and predicts nothing.

Materials follow the same rule. Cambridge syllabuses, past papers, mark schemes and grade thresholds belong to Cambridge, are published on its own site, and are referenced and linked rather than reproduced or distributed as downloads. No tutor here is described as a Cambridge examiner unless that status can be evidenced, because examiner status is widely used in this market to imply access to marking standards and paper content that nobody outside the board holds. For an Ajman parent the practical test is short. Ask a prospective tutor what they would do with a write-up your child brings to a session, and listen for whether the answer involves marking it or improving it.

faqs.question: Why is my daughter good at chemistry in class but weak on the paper?
faqs.answer: Usually because the paper rewards three different performances and her strength sits in one of them. Inorganic recall often holds up well in class discussion while the calculation strand collapses under timed conditions, and organic chemistry may not have been taught yet. Scoring a marked script strand by strand separates those in about forty minutes, and the result normally names one target rather than three. A percentage cannot do this, because it averages across exactly the division that would tell you what to work on, which is why the first session produces a scored paper rather than a plan.

faqs.question: Where exactly do students lose marks in mole calculations?
faqs.answer: At identifiable steps rather than wholesale, which is why calculations are marked line by line. Three break points recur. Students who cannot start are usually missing molar mass fluency, particularly with brackets and water of crystallisation. Students who start well and fail at the ratio have not used, or not balanced, the equation. Students who complete the chain and still drop a mark lose it on units, on significant figures, or on answering in grams where kilograms were asked. Those are three unrelated repairs, and identifying which one applies is worth more than a term of general calculation practice.

faqs.question: How do I make sure she learns the qualitative analysis answers properly?
faqs.answer: Treat them as text to be learned rather than as chemistry to be reasoned. The scheme credits particular observations, and the detail decides the mark: a white precipitate soluble in excess identifies a different ion from one insoluble in excess, and green against red-brown separates iron(II) from iron(III). Two habits recover most of these marks. Answer the question that was asked, which is usually what is seen rather than which ion it is. And learn the colour words exactly, because approximations like blue for light blue are commonly not credited. Confirm the required test set at cambridgeinternational.org for her exam year.

faqs.question: Which practical paper is my son entered for in chemistry?
faqs.answer: Check the entry documents, because the two routes need different preparation and both carry a fifth of the grade. One is a practical test taken in the school laboratory with apparatus; the other is a written paper about experiments sat at a desk. The school decides when it enters candidates, and in Ajman many families discover the answer only when a mock arrives in an unfamiliar format. Ask the head of science or the exams officer in writing, then confirm the component structure for your son's exam year at cambridgeinternational.org before buying any practical block.

faqs.question: Can titration technique be taught without a laboratory?
faqs.answer: The marked part of it, yes. Candidates rarely lose titration marks through poor handling of a burette; they lose them by recording readings to the wrong precision, by failing the concordance requirement across repeats, by averaging a rough titre in with the accurate ones, and by mishandling the calculation that follows. Every one of those is a write-up rule that can be drilled over a shared screen until it is automatic. What a tutor cannot do is stand in an Ajman school laboratory, and any provider implying otherwise should be questioned closely about what the session actually involves.

faqs.question: Why was organic chemistry missing from the mock paper?
faqs.answer: Because it is taught last in nearly every scheme of work, and the mock is set on what has been covered. That has two consequences worth planning around. A January mock mark is not evidence about roughly a third of the subject, so reading it as a total will misdirect your spending towards content the student may already hold. And the organic block should be timed to arrive with or just after the school's teaching rather than months before, because taught-then-consolidated retains and the reverse order does not.

faqs.question: What should a chemistry progress record actually show?
faqs.answer: One line per timed paper: the date, the marks available by strand, and the marks taken by strand, covering physical, inorganic and organic chemistry plus the practical and analysis content. Nothing more elaborate. That record shows uneven progress a total would hide: calculations climbing while inorganic stays flat and organic rises sharply once the school teaches it. Refuse a percentage with no denominator, a star rating not traceable to countable dated reviews, and any predicted grade presented as a commitment, because nobody can guarantee an outcome in this subject or any other.

faqs.question: Does a Core chemistry entry limit what tuition can do?
faqs.answer: Yes, and establishing it is the first job. Core candidates sit the Core multiple-choice and theory papers, and the certificate is capped at grade C regardless of how much is spent. Extended candidates sit the Extended papers with the full grade range available. A secure grade C may be exactly the right outcome for a particular student, but paying specialist rates in hope of an A on a Core entry is buying something the entry cannot award. Ask the school in writing which tier your child is entered for and when that decision is made.

faqs.question: Is separate chemistry the same as the co-ordinated science my child takes?
faqs.answer: No. Co-ordinated Sciences covers chemistry alongside physics and biology to a reduced depth, produces one or two grades rather than three, and has a practical component spanning all three subjects. A student on that route is not sitting 0620, so tuition built on 0620 past papers covers material outside their specification. Read the subject line on the statement of entry rather than relying on how the course is described at home. In Ajman households with children at two campuses, this check is worth doing separately for each child.

faqs.question: How many sessions does the calculation strand usually take?
faqs.answer: Six to ten for an Extended candidate whose break point has been identified, with written work marked between sessions. That assumes the arithmetic underneath is sound; where molar mass fluency is the problem, add two sessions at the front, because a chain taught on shaky formula-mass work does not hold. The honest measure is the before-and-after strand score on a timed set rather than a feeling about progress. If the score has not moved after that block, the approach changes rather than the number of sessions increasing.

faqs.question: Is it worth paying for chemistry if my son only needs a pass?
faqs.answer: Often a small, defined amount is, and a large open arrangement is not. For a Core candidate aiming at a secure pass, the highest-return work is narrow: the reactivity series and other pure recall, equation discipline, the simplest end of the mole chain, and the qualitative observations, which are learnable text. That is a handful of sessions rather than a nine-month commitment. Spending the mid-band monthly figure for a year to secure a grade that four well-aimed blocks would reach is the commonest avoidable expense in this market.

faqs.question: How should I compare the hourly rates quoted to us in Ajman?
faqs.answer: Divide the rate by what it is supposed to move, and insist on a defined block rather than an open arrangement. Published bands put budget and university-student online tuition at roughly AED 45 to 150 an hour, qualified online subject tutors at AED 150 to 300, in-home visits including travel at AED 180 to 500, named IB and IGCSE specialists at AED 200 to 450 and above, and premium or examiner-led tuition at AED 500 to 650 and above. Those were collected from named providers in October 2026 and are market rates, not an IB Gram price list. Ask any provider for the date and source of its own figure.

faqs.question: Will a tutor write my daughter's practical write-up for her?
faqs.answer: No. A tutor may teach how a titration write-up is structured, work a parallel calculation that is not the set question, explain why a conclusion does not follow from a set of titres, and mark her own work against the published criteria while naming each forfeited mark. A tutor does not produce the write-up she submits. In a strand-scored plan that line is structural, because a scoreboard assembled from somebody else's chemistry measures nothing. One operator in this market sells completed assessed work outright; that is a malpractice risk for the student and nothing here resembles it.

faqs.question: Are past papers and mark schemes provided as downloads?
faqs.answer: No. Cambridge syllabuses, past papers, mark schemes and grade thresholds belong to Cambridge and are published on its own site, so they are referenced and linked in sessions rather than reproduced or handed out. Reproducing them is a copyright matter and, for unreleased material, a malpractice exposure. What a session does provide is teaching summaries, worked examples written for your child, and marking against the published criteria. Any provider offering a library of boards' materials as its selling point is offering something it is not entitled to distribute.

faqs.question: What if no separate-chemistry specialist is available at our hour?
faqs.answer: You will be told before anything is booked. Extended chemistry with practical-paper and qualitative-analysis experience is narrower than general science tutoring, and the post-7pm slots most Ajman commuting households need fill first. The options then are a different hour, a short wait for one to open, or a named specialist based outside the UAE teaching on Gulf Standard Time, disclosed in advance with the rate. What you will not be offered is a general science tutor presented as a chemistry specialist, which is the substitution this market makes most quietly.

intro.heading: What a 0478 search in Ajman is really asking for
paragraphs: Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science 0478 is assessed by two written papers, each 75 marks, each 1 hour 45 minutes, each worth half the grade. Paper 1 covers computer systems: data representation, data transmission, hardware, software, the internet and its uses, and automated and emerging technologies. Paper 2 covers algorithms, programming, databases and Boolean logic. Students do develop practical programming skills during the course, but the current syllabus examines that understanding on paper, so a student who can build a working game and cannot complete a trace table will underperform badly. Check which syllabus version applies to your child's series with the school, because the assessment model has changed in recent years.

That split is why parents in Ajman often describe the problem as a mystery. The child is comfortable with computers, enjoys the subject, and comes home with mock marks in the 40s. Almost always the marks are concentrated in Paper 1 and missing from Paper 2, and inside Paper 2 they are missing from three specific question types: dry-running an algorithm through a trace table, writing pseudocode precise enough to be followed by someone who cannot guess the intent, and simplifying or completing a logic circuit. None of those is about programming talent. All three are about precision under time pressure.

Ajman has a specific supply problem here. Computer Science is a small-cohort option in most of the emirate's private schools, often taught by a teacher who also carries ICT or mathematics, and the number of people inside Ajman who have marked a 0478 Paper 2 against the published scheme is very small. That is not a criticism of the schools; it is what a small entry supports. It does mean a search for a local specialist usually returns either a general programming tutor or nobody, and both outcomes end in money spent on the wrong thing.

Scarcity is also what sets the price locally, which is why this page reports cost by the month rather than by the hour. The packages visible in this market are AED 799 a month for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to AED 1,799 a month for four two-hour in-home sessions. Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 monthly estimates for one weekly hour run AED 240 to AED 600 at the budget end, AED 600 to AED 1,200 in the middle, and AED 1,000 to AED 2,000 and above for specialist exam-year support. Those are the survey's and the providers' own figures. The hourly bands behind them — AED 150 to AED 300 for a qualified online subject tutor, AED 200 to AED 450 and above for an examined-subject specialist — appear with their sources in the tables below.

Delivery is remote and that suits this subject better than most. IB Gram matches a 0478 specialist and runs the session over live video with a shared editor, so pseudocode is typed where both people can see it and a trace table is filled in column by column live. We do not visit homes in the UAE; in-home tuition is a service IB Gram offers only in India. For a subject whose entire working material is text and tables on a screen, that limit costs a student nothing.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science (0478)
programmes.description: Two years, two written papers, no coursework. Paper 1 is largely factual and improves with disciplined revision. Paper 2 is procedural and improves only with practice at writing and tracing algorithms. The grade distribution in most sets is bimodal for exactly that reason: students who practised Paper 2 technique and students who revised Paper 1 twice as hard and hoped.

sections.heading: Why 0478 is the scarcest subject in Ajman, and what scarcity costs
paragraphs: Scarcity is the real story behind a 0478 price in this emirate, and it is worth separating from the usual complaints about tutoring costs. Ajman's private-school set is compact, Computer Science is a minority option inside it, and the subject has only been examined in its current form for a few years. The result is a very small local population of people who have taught the syllabus and marked its second paper, and an abundant local population of people who can program. Those are not the same skill, and a parent paying for the second while needing the first is the most common waste of money in this subject.

What scarcity does to a quote is predictable. It pushes the subject out of the general band and into the examined-specialist band: from AED 150 to AED 300 an hour for a qualified online subject tutor, to AED 200 to AED 450 and above per Bestimate's 2026 figures, with TutorChase quoting AED 270. It also lengthens the wait, because the few people who do this work are already teaching several cohorts. And it creates a specific local distortion: in-home quotes in Ajman for 0478 are often higher than for mathematics or English simply because the tutor is driving further, from Sharjah or Dubai, to reach the handful of families who need it.

The structural answer is to stop searching geographically. A 0478 specialist does not need to be in Ajman, in Sharjah or in the UAE at all; they need to have marked the papers. Remote delivery converts a radius search into a subject search, which is the single largest improvement available to a family in this emirate for this particular subject. It also removes the travel component from the price, which is the one part of an in-home figure that buys no teaching whatsoever.

sections.heading: Paper 1 and Paper 2: where 0478 marks actually go
paragraphs: The two papers are equal in weight and completely unequal in difficulty profile. Paper 1, Computer Systems, carries 75 marks over 1 hour 45 minutes and tests six areas: data representation, data transmission, hardware, software, the internet and its uses, and automated and emerging technologies. It is a knowledge paper. A diligent student with past papers and a glossary can move their Paper 1 mark substantially without any help at all, and should be encouraged to try before anybody is paid.

Paper 2, Algorithms, Programming and Logic, also carries 75 marks over 1 hour 45 minutes, and it is where grades are decided. Its four areas are algorithm design and problem-solving, programming, databases and Boolean logic. The questions are procedural: complete this trace table, find the error in this pseudocode, write an algorithm that does this, write a query that returns these records, simplify this logic expression. Each one has a right answer that is checkable, which is both the good news and the bad news — there is nowhere to hide a vague understanding.

The commonest mark loss on Paper 2 is also the most fixable. Students write pseudocode that a sympathetic human can follow and a mark scheme cannot: a loop with no termination condition, a counter that is never initialised, an output statement that assumes the reader knows what the variable represents. Nothing about this is a programming deficiency; the same student will write working Python. It is a precision deficiency, and it responds to line-by-line marking faster than to any amount of additional content teaching. The full assessment detail for both papers sits on the Cambridge International site under syllabus code 0478.

sections.heading: Trace tables, pseudocode and the Paper 2 questions that move a grade
paragraphs: A trace table is the most honest question type in 0478. The student is given an algorithm and a set of inputs and must record what every variable holds after every step. There is no partial credit for understanding the idea: either the values are right or they are not. Students lose marks in three identifiable ways — skipping rows because the pattern seems obvious, forgetting to record a variable that changes inside a loop, and recording the final value of a counter rather than its value at the point the question asked about.

The repair is unglamorous and quick. Fill the table one row at a time, out loud, without looking ahead. Write the value of every variable in the header row even if it has not changed. Treat the loop condition as a separate step rather than as part of the line above. Most students who practise this deliberately for three or four sessions stop losing trace-table marks entirely, which on a paper worth half the grade is a visible movement for a small amount of work.

Pseudocode is the second cluster. The mark scheme does not reward elegance and does not punish verbosity; it rewards an algorithm that would actually work if followed literally by someone with no idea what it was for. So every variable gets initialised, every loop gets a termination condition, every input gets a prompt, every output says what it is outputting. Students who have learned to program in Python frequently write pseudocode that depends on Python's conveniences and lose marks for assumptions the examiner cannot grant. Teaching that distinction is most of what a 0478 specialist does in the first month.

Boolean logic is the third, and it is the area where a systematic method beats intuition most decisively. Truth tables completed by reasoning about what the circuit 'does' go wrong under exam pressure. Truth tables completed mechanically, all input combinations listed in binary counting order, then each gate evaluated column by column, do not. It is a drill, not an insight, and a tutor who treats it as an insight will spend four sessions on something that takes one.

sections.heading: What a 0478 session looks like on a shared screen
paragraphs: Parents reasonably want to know what they are buying, especially for a subject they cannot assess themselves. A 0478 session over live video opens with the previous week's homework already marked: an algorithm the student wrote, annotated line by line, with each lost mark attributed to a specific rule rather than to a general comment. The student reads the annotations before anything new starts, because correction only works if the student does the correcting.

The middle of the session is a shared editor with the pseudocode typed into it. The tutor does not write the algorithm. The student writes it, the tutor asks the questions that expose the gaps — what happens if the list is empty, what is the counter set to before the loop, how does this terminate — and the student fixes it. Then it is traced, in a table built live beside the code, with the tutor filling nothing in. This is slower than being shown a model answer and it is the only version that transfers to an exam hall.

The session ends with a specific instruction for the week, not with a topic. 'Practise algorithms' is not an instruction. 'Write and trace three algorithms that search a list, and in each one initialise every variable before the loop' is. That specificity is also what lets a parent see whether the money is working: there is a marked artefact every week, with a mark and a reason, and the reasons should change over time as earlier faults disappear.

paragraphs: Hourly rates are the wrong unit for a two-year subject, and 0478 is usually a two-year commitment for the students who need it. Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 monthly estimates for a single weekly hour run AED 240 to AED 600 at the budget end, AED 600 to AED 1,200 in the middle, and AED 1,000 to AED 2,000 and above for specialist exam-year support.

sections.heading: 0478 and UAE Ministry of Education equivalency
paragraphs: Families planning on a UAE university need to understand equivalency, and it is one of the subjects no competitor page in this market addresses at all. For the British track, reporting on the Ministry's clarification states that students must pass five accredited subjects in GCSE or IGCSE certificates with a grade of no less than E or grade 3, and must submit proof of one accredited subject at Advanced Level with a grade no lower than E, or two accredited subjects at Advanced Subsidiary Level at the same grade. Arabic and Islamic education are not included among the five required subjects.

Computer Science 0478 counts as one of those five accredited subjects on the same basis as any other IGCSE. The practical implication is reassuring: choosing 0478 does not disadvantage a student in the equivalency count, and the five-subject rule means a student with a weak sixth subject is not automatically in difficulty. One ranking competitor in this market publishes a six-subject requirement, which is wrong, and publishing the correct figure is a small but real accuracy advantage.

Two cautions belong here. First, the American-track requirements are different again — English proficiency via a score of 5 in IELTS academic, 61 in TOEFL iBT, or 450 in the SAT reading and writing section, and mathematics via at least 450 in SAT Math — and no IB points threshold appears in the sourced reporting, so no figure for the IB route is published on this page. Verify everything against moe.gov.ae or the emirate's attestation authority before acting on it. Second, equivalency and attestation are processes the Ministry performs, not services IB Gram provides or guarantees, and nobody should tell you tutoring is required for either.
